have hUnit : ∀ T : Sys.SetTh.T, Sys.SetTh.le T (Sys.traceSet (Sys.defSyn T)) :=
    fun T ↦ (Sys.defSyn_le_iff T (Sys.defSyn T)).mp (Sys.ClsTh.le_refl _)
  refine ⟨⟨Sys.ClsTh.le_trans (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_left _ _) hPush.2,
      Sys.ClsTh.le_trans (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_right _ _) hPush.2,
      fun Z h1 h2 ↦ Sys.ClsTh.le_trans hPush.1 (Sys.ClsTh.sup_le h1 h2)⟩,
    fun X ↦ ⟨fun ⟨hX0, _⟩ ↦
        Sys.defSyn_mono (Sys.SetTh.le_trans ((Sys.defSyn_le_iff X E₀).mp hX0) hCons.1),
      fun hXT ↦ ⟨(Sys.defSyn_le_iff X E₀).mpr (Sys.SetTh.le_trans (Sys.SetTh.le_trans
        ((Sys.defSyn_le_iff X (Sys.defSyn T₀)).mp hXT) (Sys.defSyn_cons T₀)) hCons.2),
        Sys.ClsTh.le_trans hXT (Sys.defSyn_mono hT)⟩⟩,
    fun X ↦ ⟨fun ⟨hX0, _⟩ ↦ Sys.SetTh.le_trans hX0 hCons.1,
      fun hXT ↦ ⟨Sys.SetTh.le_trans hXT hCons.2, Sys.SetTh.le_trans hXT hT⟩⟩,
    fun L₀ X hXL hXT1 hNT0 ↦ ⟨(Sys.defSyn_le_iff X L₀).mpr hXL, Sys.defSyn_mono hXT1, fun hle ↦
      hNT0 (Sys.SetTh.le_trans (hUnit X)
        (Sys.SetTh.le_trans (Sys.traceSet_mono hle) (Sys.defSyn_cons T₀)))⟩⟩

nodes.statement: Over Replacement-free, Choice-free GB_0, von Neumann's Limitation of Size (LoS: every class C is either small or surjects onto V, and not both) is strictly equivalent to the conjunction of Class Replacement (Rep) and Global Choice (GC). Moreover, over GB_0, Rep and GC are mutually independent: (Rep /\ ~GC /\ ~LoS) holds in tail Easton models with no definable selector, and (GC /\ ~Rep /\ ~LoS) holds in Godel's countable-cofinality constructible spine (L_{omega_omega^L}, Def(L_{omega_omega^L})).

/-- Image predicate `f[A]` inside `Obj`. -/
def imgOf {Obj : Type} (A : Obj → Prop) (f : Obj → Obj) : Obj → Prop := fun y ↦ ∃ x, A x ∧ f x = y

/-- Abstract `GB₀` class-set system with smallness, proper ordinals `Ord`, and diagonalization. -/
structure GB0ClassSystem : Type 1 where
  /-- Universe, membership, classes, small sets, `Ord`, admissible maps, and `GB₀` axioms. -/
  Obj : Type
  mem : Obj → Obj → Prop
  IsClass : (Obj → Prop) → Prop
  IsSmall : (Obj → Prop) → Prop
  Ord : Obj → Prop
  AdmissibleFun : (Obj → Prop) → (Obj → Obj) → Prop
  ext_class : ∀ {C₁ C₂}, (∀ x, C₁ x ↔ C₂ x) → IsClass C₁ → IsClass C₂
  ext_small : ∀ {A₁ A₂}, (∀ x, A₁ x ↔ A₂ x) → IsSmall A₁ → IsSmall A₂
  small_isClass : ∀ {A}, IsSmall A → IsClass A
  small_or_proper : ∀ C, IsClass C → IsSmall C ∨ ¬ IsSmall C
  v_isClass : IsClass (fun _ ↦ True)
  ord_isClass : IsClass Ord
  ord_not_small : ¬ IsSmall Ord
  admissible_id : ∀ C, IsClass C → AdmissibleFun C id
  admissible_comp : ∀ A f g,
    AdmissibleFun A f → AdmissibleFun (imgOf A f) g → AdmissibleFun A (g ∘ f)
  img_isClass : ∀ A f, IsSmall A → AdmissibleFun A f → IsClass (imgOf A f)
  diag_sep : ∀ A f,
    IsSmall A → AdmissibleFun A f → ∃ d : Obj, ∀ a, A a → (mem a d ↔ ¬ mem a (f a))
  ord_surj_to_bij : (∃ p, AdmissibleFun Ord p ∧ ∀ y, ∃ x, Ord x ∧ p x = y) →
    ∃ f g, AdmissibleFun (fun _ ↦ True) f ∧ AdmissibleFun Ord g ∧
      (∀ x, Ord (f x)) ∧ (∀ x, g (f x) = x) ∧ (∀ y, Ord y → f (g y) = y)
  ord_collapse : (∀ A f, IsSmall A → AdmissibleFun A f → IsSmall (imgOf A f)) →
    (∃ f g, AdmissibleFun (fun _ ↦ True) f ∧ AdmissibleFun Ord g ∧
      (∀ x, Ord (f x)) ∧ (∀ x, g (f x) = x) ∧ (∀ y, Ord y → f (g y) = y)) →
    ∀ C, IsClass C → ¬ IsSmall C → ∃ h, AdmissibleFun C h ∧ ∀ y, ∃ x, C x ∧ h x = y

/-- Class surjection `f : C ↠ D` inside `GB0ClassSystem`. -/
def GB0ClassSystem.IsClassSurj (S : GB0ClassSystem) (C D : S.Obj → Prop) (f : S.Obj → S.Obj) :
    Prop := S.AdmissibleFun C f ∧ (∀ x, C x → D (f x)) ∧ (∀ y, D y → ∃ x, C x ∧ f x = y)

/-- Class bijection `(f, g) : C ↔ D` inside `GB0ClassSystem`. -/
def GB0ClassSystem.IsClassBij (S : GB0ClassSystem) (C D : S.Obj → Prop) (f g : S.Obj → S.Obj) :
    Prop := S.AdmissibleFun C f ∧ S.AdmissibleFun D g ∧ (∀ x, C x → D (f x)) ∧
  (∀ y, D y → C (g y)) ∧ (∀ x, C x → g (f x) = x) ∧ (∀ y, D y → f (g y) = y)

/-- Limitation of Size (`LoS`): every class is small or surjects onto `V` (mutually exclusive). -/
def SatisfiesLoS (S : GB0ClassSystem) : Prop :=
  ∀ C, S.IsClass C →
    (S.IsSmall C ∨ ∃ f, S.IsClassSurj C (fun _ ↦ True) f) ∧
    (S.IsSmall C → ¬ ∃ f, S.IsClassSurj C (fun _ ↦ True) f)
/-- Class Replacement (`Rep`): small images of small sets are small. -/
def SatisfiesClassReplacement (S : GB0ClassSystem) : Prop :=
  ∀ A f, S.IsSmall A → S.AdmissibleFun A f → S.IsSmall (imgOf A f)
/-- Global Choice (`GC`) in ordinal-bijection form `V ↔ Ord`. -/
def SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection (S : GB0ClassSystem) : Prop :=
  ∃ f g, S.IsClassBij (fun _ ↦ True) S.Ord f g

/-- Russell–Cantor diagonal theorem: no small set surjects onto `V`. -/
theorem no_small_surj_V (S : GB0ClassSystem) (A : S.Obj → Prop) (hA : S.IsSmall A)
    (f : S.Obj → S.Obj) : ¬ S.IsClassSurj A (fun _ ↦ True) f := by
  intro ⟨hf, _, hSurj⟩; rcases S.diag_sep A f hA hf with ⟨d, hd⟩
  rcases hSurj d trivial with ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩
  have h1 := hd a ha; rw [hfa] at h1
  have hn : ¬ S.mem a d := fun h ↦ h1.mp h h
  exact hn (h1.mpr hn)

/-- **Unbundling Limitation of Size Over `GB₀` (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    `SatisfiesLoS S ↔ (SatisfiesClassReplacement S ∧ SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection S)`. -/
theorem gb0_los_iff_rep_and_gc (S : GB0ClassSystem) :
    SatisfiesLoS S ↔ (SatisfiesClassReplacement S ∧ SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection S) := by
  constructor
  · intro hLoS; refine ⟨fun A f hA hf ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases (hLoS (imgOf A f) (S.img_isClass A f hA hf)).1 with hS | ⟨q, hq⟩
      · exact hS
      · exact False.elim (no_small_surj_V S A hA (q ∘ f)
          ⟨S.admissible_comp A f q hf hq.1, fun _ _ ↦ trivial, fun y _ ↦ by
            rcases hq.2.2 y trivial with ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hqz⟩; exact ⟨x, hx, hqz⟩⟩)
    · rcases (hLoS S.Ord S.ord_isClass).1 with hS | ⟨p, hp⟩
      · exact False.elim (S.ord_not_small hS)
      · rcases S.ord_surj_to_bij ⟨p, hp.1, fun y ↦ hp.2.2 y trivial⟩
          with ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hOrd, hgf, hfg⟩
        exact ⟨f, g, hf, hg, fun x _ ↦ hOrd x, fun _ _ ↦ trivial, fun x _ ↦ hgf x, hfg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hRep, f, g, hf, hg, hOrd, _, hgf, hfg⟩ C hC
    have hGC : ∃ f' g', S.AdmissibleFun (fun _ ↦ True) f' ∧ S.AdmissibleFun S.Ord g' ∧
        (∀ x, S.Ord (f' x)) ∧ (∀ x, g' (f' x) = x) ∧ (∀ y, S.Ord y → f' (g' y) = y) :=
      ⟨f, g, hf, hg, fun x ↦ hOrd x trivial, fun x ↦ hgf x trivial, hfg⟩
    rcases S.small_or_proper C hC with hS | hNS
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hS, fun _ ⟨h, hh⟩ ↦ no_small_surj_V S C hS h hh⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr (let ⟨h, ha, hSurj⟩ := S.ord_collapse hRep hGC C hC hNS
        ⟨h, ha, fun _ _ ↦ trivial, fun y _ ↦ hSurj y⟩), fun hS ↦ False.elim (hNS hS)⟩

private def natEq : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, 0 => true | 0, _ + 1 => false | _ + 1, 0 => false | m + 1, n + 1 => natEq m n
private theorem natEq_refl : ∀ n, natEq n n = true
  | 0 => rfl | n + 1 => natEq_refl n
private theorem natEq_eq : ∀ {m n}, natEq m n = true → m = n
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl | 0, _ + 1, h => Bool.noConfusion h
  | _ + 1, 0, h => Bool.noConfusion h | _ + 1, _ + 1, h => congrArg Nat.succ (natEq_eq h)

/-- Inductive hereditarily finite tagged universe witnessing `Rep ∧ ¬GC`. -/
inductive RepObj : Type
  | atom : Bool → Nat → RepObj
  | nil : RepObj
  | cons : RepObj → RepObj → RepObj
private def repEq : RepObj → RepObj → Bool
  | .atom b₁ n₁, .atom b₂ n₂ => match b₁, b₂ with
    | false, false => natEq n₁ n₂ | true, true => natEq n₁ n₂
    | false, true => false | true, false => false
  | .atom _ _, .nil => false | .atom _ _, .cons _ _ => false
  | .nil, .atom _ _ => false | .nil, .nil => true | .nil, .cons _ _ => false
  | .cons _ _, .atom _ _ => false | .cons _ _, .nil => false
  | .cons a₁ t₁, .cons a₂ t₂ => match repEq a₁ a₂ with | true => repEq t₁ t₂ | false => false
private theorem repEq_refl : ∀ x : RepObj, repEq x x = true
  | .atom false n => natEq_refl n | .atom true n => natEq_refl n
  | .nil => rfl | .cons a t => by dsimp only [repEq]; rw [repEq_refl a, repEq_refl t]
private theorem repEq_eq : ∀ {x y : RepObj}, repEq x y = true → x = y
  | .atom false _, .atom false _, h => congrArg (RepObj.atom false) (natEq_eq h)
  | .atom true _, .atom true _, h => congrArg (RepObj.atom true) (natEq_eq h)
  | .atom false _, .atom true _, h | .atom true _, .atom false _, h => Bool.noConfusion h
  | .nil, .nil, _ => rfl
  | .cons a₁ t₁, .cons a₂ t₂, h => by
    dsimp only [repEq] at h; cases ha : repEq a₁ a₂
    · rw [ha] at h; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    · rw [ha] at h; rw [repEq_eq ha, repEq_eq h]
  | .atom _ _, .nil, h | .atom _ _, .cons _ _, h | .nil, .atom _ _, h
  | .nil, .cons _ _, h | .cons _ _, .atom _ _, h | .cons _ _, .nil, h => Bool.noConfusion h
private def repTag : RepObj → Bool
  | .atom b _ => b | .nil => true | .cons _ _ => true
private def repMemBool (x : RepObj) : RepObj → Bool
  | .atom _ _ => false | .nil => false
  | .cons a t => match repEq x a with | true => true | false => repMemBool x t
private def diagRep (f : RepObj → RepObj) : List RepObj → RepObj
  | [] => .nil
  | a :: tl => match repMemBool a (f a) with
    | true => diagRep f tl
    | false => .cons a (diagRep f tl)
private theorem diagRep_mp (f : RepObj → RepObj) :
    ∀ L x, repMemBool x (diagRep f L) = true → ¬ (repMemBool x (f x) = true)
  | [], _, h => Bool.noConfusion h
  | a :: tl, x, h => by
    dsimp only [diagRep] at h; cases hfa : repMemBool a (f a)
    · rw [hfa] at h; dsimp only [repMemBool] at h; cases hxa : repEq x a
      · rw [hxa] at h; exact diagRep_mp f tl x h
      · rw [repEq_eq hxa, hfa]; exact Bool.false_ne_true
    · rw [hfa] at h; exact diagRep_mp f tl x h
private theorem diagRep_mpr (f : RepObj → RepObj) :
    ∀ {L x}, x ∈ L → ¬ (repMemBool x (f x) = true) → repMemBool x (diagRep f L) = true
  | _ :: _, x, .head _, hnx => by
    dsimp only [diagRep]; cases hfx : repMemBool x (f x)
    · dsimp only [repMemBool]; rw [repEq_refl x]
    · exact False.elim (hnx hfx)
  | a :: tl, x, .tail _ hm, hnx => by
    dsimp only [diagRep]; have ih := diagRep_mpr f hm hnx
    cases repMemBool a (f a)
    · dsimp only [repMemBool]; cases repEq x a
      · exact ih
      · rfl
    · exact ih
private theorem list_mem_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) :
    ∀ {L : List α} {x : α}, x ∈ L → f x ∈ List.map f L
  | _ :: _, _, .head _ => List.Mem.head _
  | _ :: _, _, .tail _ h => List.Mem.tail _ (list_mem_map f h)
private def sumAtom : List RepObj → Nat
  | [] => 0 | .atom _ n :: tl => (n + 1) + sumAtom tl
  | .nil :: tl => sumAtom tl | .cons _ _ :: tl => sumAtom tl
private theorem atom_lt_sumAtom :
    ∀ {L : List RepObj} {b : Bool} {n : Nat}, RepObj.atom b n ∈ L → n < sumAtom L
  | .atom _ _ :: _, _, _, .head _ => Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  | .atom _ _ :: tl, b, _, .tail _ h =>
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (atom_lt_sumAtom (L := tl) (b := b) h) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  | .nil :: tl, b, _, .tail _ h => atom_lt_sumAtom (L := tl) (b := b) h
  | .cons _ _ :: tl, b, _, .tail _ h => atom_lt_sumAtom (L := tl) (b := b) h
@[reducible] private def finSmall {α : Type} (A : α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ L : List α, ∀ x, A x → x ∈ L
private theorem finSmall_ext {α : Type} {A₁ A₂ : α → Prop}
    (h : ∀ x, A₁ x ↔ A₂ x) : finSmall A₁ → finSmall A₂ :=
  fun ⟨L, hL⟩ ↦ ⟨L, fun x hx ↦ hL x ((h x).mpr hx)⟩
@[reducible] private def rkSmall {α : Type} (rk : α → Nat) (A : α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ N : Nat, ∀ x, A x → rk x < N
private theorem rkSmall_ext {α : Type} (rk : α → Nat) {A₁ A₂ : α → Prop}
    (h : ∀ x, A₁ x ↔ A₂ x) : rkSmall rk A₁ → rkSmall rk A₂ :=
  fun ⟨N, hN⟩ ↦ ⟨N, fun x hx ↦ hN x ((h x).mpr hx)⟩
private theorem cls_congr {α : Type} {S : (α → Prop) → Prop}
    (hS : ∀ {A B : α → Prop}, (∀ x, A x ↔ B x) → S A → S B)
    {C₁ C₂ : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x, C₁ x ↔ C₂ x) : (S C₁ ∨ ¬ S C₁) → (S C₂ ∨ ¬ S C₂) :=
  fun hC ↦ hC.elim (fun h1 ↦ Or.inl (hS h h1))
    (fun h2 ↦ Or.inr (fun h1 ↦ h2 (hS (fun x ↦ (h x).symm) h1)))
private theorem cls_id {α : Type} {S : (α → Prop) → Prop}
    (hS : ∀ {A B : α → Prop}, (∀ x, A x ↔ B x) → S A → S B) (C : α → Prop) :
    (S C ∨ ¬ S C) → (S (imgOf C id) ∨ ¬ S (imgOf C id)) :=
  cls_congr hS fun _ ↦ ⟨fun hx ↦ ⟨_, hx, rfl⟩, fun ⟨_, hy, he⟩ ↦ he ▸ hy⟩
private theorem cls_comp {α : Type} {S : (α → Prop) → Prop}
    (hS : ∀ {A B : α → Prop}, (∀ x, A x ↔ B x) → S A → S B) (A : α → Prop) (f g : α → α) :
    (S (imgOf (imgOf A f) g) ∨ ¬ S (imgOf (imgOf A f) g)) →
    (S (imgOf A (g ∘ f)) ∨ ¬ S (imgOf A (g ∘ f))) :=
  cls_congr hS fun _ ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨x, hx, hy⟩, fun ⟨x, hx, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨f x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hy⟩⟩

/-- Independence witness 1 (`Rep ∧ ¬GC ∧ ¬LoS`): tagged universe `RepObj`. -/
@[reducible] def repNoGCModel : GB0ClassSystem where
  Obj := RepObj; mem x y := repMemBool x y = true
  IsClass C := finSmall C ∨ ¬ finSmall C; IsSmall := finSmall; Ord x := repTag x = false
  AdmissibleFun A f := (∀ x, A x → repTag (f x) = repTag x) ∧
    (finSmall (imgOf A f) ∨ ¬ finSmall (imgOf A f))
  ext_class h hC := cls_congr finSmall_ext h hC
  ext_small h hA := finSmall_ext h hA
  small_isClass := Or.inl; small_or_proper _ h := h
  v_isClass := Or.inr fun ⟨L, hL⟩ ↦
    Nat.lt_irrefl _ (atom_lt_sumAtom (hL (.atom true (sumAtom L)) trivial))
  ord_isClass := Or.inr fun ⟨L, hL⟩ ↦
    Nat.lt_irrefl _ (atom_lt_sumAtom (hL (.atom false (sumAtom L)) rfl))
  ord_not_small := fun ⟨L, hL⟩ ↦
    Nat.lt_irrefl _ (atom_lt_sumAtom (hL (.atom false (sumAtom L)) rfl))
  admissible_id C hC := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl, cls_id finSmall_ext C hC⟩
  admissible_comp A f g hf hg :=
    ⟨fun x hx ↦ (hg.1 (f x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩).trans (hf.1 x hx), cls_comp finSmall_ext A f g hg.2⟩
  img_isClass _ _ _ hf := hf.2
  diag_sep A f hA _ :=
    let ⟨L, hL⟩ := hA; ⟨diagRep f L, fun a ha ↦ ⟨diagRep_mp f L a, diagRep_mpr f (hL a ha)⟩⟩
  ord_surj_to_bij h := by
    rcases h with ⟨p, hp, hSurj⟩; rcases hSurj (.atom true 0) with ⟨x, hx, hpx⟩
    have ht := hp.1 x hx; rw [hpx] at ht; exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (ht.trans hx))
  ord_collapse _ hGC _ _ _ := by
    rcases hGC with ⟨f, _, hf, _, hOrd, _, _⟩
    exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion
      ((hf.1 (.atom true 0) trivial).symm.trans (hOrd (.atom true 0))))

/-- Replacement holds constructively in `repNoGCModel`. -/
theorem repNoGCModel_rep : SatisfiesClassReplacement repNoGCModel := by
  intro A f ⟨L, hL⟩ _; exact ⟨List.map f L, fun _ ⟨x, hx, hy⟩ ↦ hy ▸ list_mem_map f (hL x hx)⟩

/-- Global Choice fails in `repNoGCModel`. -/
theorem repNoGCModel_not_gc : ¬ SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection repNoGCModel := by
  rintro ⟨f, _, hf, _, hOrd, _, _, _⟩
  exact Bool.noConfusion ((hf.1 (.atom true 0) trivial).symm.trans (hOrd (.atom true 0) trivial))

/-- Cumulative-union ranks of the countable-cofinality spine `L_{ω_ω^L}`. -/
def SpineCum : Nat → Type
  | 0 => Nat | n + 1 => SpineCum n ⊕ (SpineCum n → Bool)
/-- Strict rank slices `SpineRank n` of the ordinal spine `L_{ω_ω^L}`. -/
def SpineRank : Nat → Type
  | 0 => Nat | n + 1 => SpineCum n → Bool
/-- Objects of the countable-cofinality ordinal spine `L_{ω_ω^L}`. -/
abbrev SpineObj : Type := Σ n : Nat, SpineRank n
private def fromCum : ∀ {n : Nat}, SpineCum n → SpineObj
  | 0, k => ⟨0, k⟩ | _ + 1, .inl u => fromCum u | n + 1, .inr g => ⟨n + 1, g⟩
private def toCum : SpineObj → ∀ n : Nat, Option (SpineCum n)
  | ⟨0, k⟩, 0 => some k | ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, 0 => none
  | ⟨0, k⟩, n + 1 => match toCum ⟨0, k⟩ n with | none => none | some u => some (.inl u)
  | ⟨m + 1, g⟩, n + 1 => if h : m = n then some (.inr (h ▸ g))
    else match toCum ⟨m + 1, g⟩ n with | none => none | some u => some (.inl u)
private theorem toCum_fromCum :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : SpineObj), x.1 ≤ n → ∃ c : SpineCum n, toCum x n = some c ∧ fromCum c = x
  | 0, ⟨0, k⟩, _ => ⟨k, rfl, rfl⟩
  | 0, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, h => False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _ h)
  | n + 1, ⟨0, k⟩, _ => by
    rcases toCum_fromCum n ⟨0, k⟩ (Nat.zero_le n) with ⟨c, hc, hf⟩
    refine ⟨.inl c, ?_, hf⟩; dsimp only [toCum]; rw [hc]
  | n + 1, ⟨m + 1, g⟩, h => by
    by_cases hmn : m = n
    · subst hmn; refine ⟨.inr g, ?_, rfl⟩; dsimp only [toCum]; rw [dif_pos rfl]
    · have hle : m + 1 ≤ n :=
        Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne h (fun he ↦ hmn (Nat.succ.inj he)))
      rcases toCum_fromCum n ⟨m + 1, g⟩ hle with ⟨c, hc, hf⟩
      refine ⟨.inl c, ?_, hf⟩; dsimp only [toCum]; rw [dif_neg hmn, hc]
/-- Decidable membership on `SpineObj`. -/
def spineMemBool (x : SpineObj) : SpineObj → Bool
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => false
  | ⟨n + 1, g⟩ => match toCum x n with | none => false | some c => g c
private theorem spineMem_succ (x : SpineObj) (N : Nat) (g : SpineCum N → Bool)
    (c : SpineCum N) (hc : toCum x N = some c) :
    spineMemBool x ⟨N + 1, g⟩ = g c := by
  dsimp only [spineMemBool]; rw [hc]
private def spineZero : ∀ n : Nat, SpineRank n
  | 0 => (0 : Nat) | _ + 1 => fun _ ↦ false
private theorem gcNoRep_not_rep_aux
    (hRep : ∀ (A : SpineObj → Prop) (f : SpineObj → SpineObj), rkSmall Sigma.fst A →
      (rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf A f) ∨ ¬ rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf A f)) →
      rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf A f)) : False := by
  have hS : rkSmall Sigma.fst (fun x : SpineObj ↦ x.1 = 0) := ⟨1, fun x hx ↦ hx ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let f : SpineObj → SpineObj | ⟨0, (n : Nat)⟩ => ⟨n, spineZero n⟩ | ⟨_ + 1, _⟩ => ⟨0, (0 : Nat)⟩
  have hU : ¬ rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf (fun x : SpineObj ↦ x.1 = 0) f) := fun ⟨M, hM⟩ ↦
    Nat.lt_irrefl M (hM ⟨M, spineZero M⟩ ⟨⟨0, (M : Nat)⟩, rfl, rfl⟩)
  exact hU (hRep _ f hS (Or.inr hU))
private theorem spine_unb : ¬ rkSmall Sigma.fst (fun _ : SpineObj ↦ True) :=
  fun ⟨N, hN⟩ ↦ Nat.lt_irrefl N (hN ⟨N, spineZero N⟩ trivial)

/-- Independence witness 2 (`GC ∧ ¬Rep ∧ ¬LoS`): ordinal spine modeling `(L_{ω_ω^L}, Def)`. -/
@[reducible] def gcNoRepModel : GB0ClassSystem where
  Obj := SpineObj; mem x y := spineMemBool x y = true
  IsClass C := rkSmall Sigma.fst C ∨ ¬ rkSmall Sigma.fst C
  IsSmall := rkSmall Sigma.fst; Ord _ := True
  AdmissibleFun A f := rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf A f) ∨ ¬ rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf A f)
  ext_class h hC := cls_congr (rkSmall_ext Sigma.fst) h hC
  ext_small h hA := rkSmall_ext Sigma.fst h hA
  small_isClass := Or.inl; small_or_proper _ h := h
  v_isClass := Or.inr spine_unb; ord_isClass := Or.inr spine_unb; ord_not_small := spine_unb
  admissible_id C hC := cls_id (rkSmall_ext Sigma.fst) C hC
  admissible_comp A f g _ hg := cls_comp (rkSmall_ext Sigma.fst) A f g hg
  img_isClass _ _ _ hf := hf
  diag_sep A f hA _ := by
    rcases hA with ⟨N, hN⟩
    refine ⟨⟨N + 1, fun c ↦ !(spineMemBool (fromCum c) (f (fromCum c)))⟩, fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases toCum_fromCum N a (Nat.le_of_lt (hN a ha)) with ⟨c, hc, hfc⟩
    have hEq := spineMem_succ a N (fun c ↦ !(spineMemBool (fromCum c) (f (fromCum c)))) c hc
    change spineMemBool a ⟨N + 1, fun c ↦ !(spineMemBool (fromCum c) (f (fromCum c)))⟩ = true ↔
      ¬ (spineMemBool a (f a) = true)
    rw [hEq]; dsimp only; rw [hfc]; cases spineMemBool a (f a) <;> decide
  ord_surj_to_bij _ :=
    let u : ¬ rkSmall Sigma.fst (imgOf (fun _ : SpineObj ↦ True) id) :=
      fun ⟨N, hN⟩ ↦ Nat.lt_irrefl N (hN ⟨N, spineZero N⟩ ⟨⟨N, spineZero N⟩, trivial, rfl⟩)
    ⟨id, id, Or.inr u, Or.inr u, fun _ ↦ trivial, fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
  ord_collapse hRep _ _ _ _ := False.elim (gcNoRep_not_rep_aux hRep)

/-- Global Choice holds in `gcNoRepModel`. -/
theorem gcNoRepModel_gc : SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection gcNoRepModel :=
  ⟨id, id, gcNoRepModel.admissible_id _ gcNoRepModel.v_isClass,
    gcNoRepModel.admissible_id _ gcNoRepModel.ord_isClass,
    fun _ _ ↦ trivial, fun _ _ ↦ trivial, fun _ _ ↦ rfl, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩

/-- Replacement fails constructively in `gcNoRepModel` via the cofinal `ω_n^L` spine. -/
theorem gcNoRepModel_not_rep : ¬ SatisfiesClassReplacement gcNoRepModel := gcNoRep_not_rep_aux

/-- **LoS Unbundling & `2×2` Independence Theorem (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Proves `LoS ↔ (Rep ∧ GC)` over any `GB0ClassSystem` together with both separating witnesses
    `repNoGCModel` (`Rep ∧ ¬GC ∧ ¬LoS`) and `gcNoRepModel` (`GC ∧ ¬Rep ∧ ¬LoS`). -/
theorem los_unbundling_and_independence :
    (∀ S : GB0ClassSystem,
      SatisfiesLoS S ↔ (SatisfiesClassReplacement S ∧ SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection S)) ∧
    (SatisfiesClassReplacement repNoGCModel ∧ ¬ SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection repNoGCModel ∧
      ¬ SatisfiesLoS repNoGCModel) ∧
    (SatisfiesProperClassOrdBijection gcNoRepModel ∧ ¬ SatisfiesClassReplacement gcNoRepModel ∧
      ¬ SatisfiesLoS gcNoRepModel) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

nodes.title: Easton Tail Homogeneity Leaves Card -> Set Unsplit Under Def(M)

dual_pillars.purpose: Tail Easton class-forcing homogeneity yielding ZFC + forall p (V != HOD({p}))
Calibration of weak categorical equivalence splitting vs. Choice
Global Choice equivalence and NBG conservativity over ZFC

nodes.statement: By homogeneity of tail Easton class-forcing extensions (Easton 1970, pp. 139-178), there exist models M |= ZFC + forall p (V != HOD({p})) in which no set parameter p defines a global well-ordering; consequently (M, Def(M)) |= GBC + ~GC leaves Makkai's large weak categorical equivalence Card >-> Set unsplit (Makkai 1996; Felgner 1971). Crucially, bare V != HOD is insufficient because adding a single Cohen real c over L yields L[c] |= V != HOD yet <_{L[c]} in Def(L[c]) still splits Card >-> Set.
nodes.tex:
\begin{inlineclaim}[Easton Tail Homogeneity and Unsplit $\mathbf{Card} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Set}$ Under {{sym:def-functor}}(M)]\label{ch02:claim:easton-hod-unsplit-card}%
\uses{ch02:thm:def-left-adjoint-coreflection,ch02:prop:los-unbundling-independence}%
Lifting Michael Makkai's equivalence-splitting calibration~\cite{makkai1996} from small categories to $\mathbf{Cat}(\mathcal{C})$ over {{sym:gbc}}, splitting the weak equivalence $I : \mathbf{Card} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Set}$ via a class quasi-inverse functor is equivalent to Global Choice ({{sym:nbg}})~\cite{felgner1971}. By homogeneity of tail Easton class-forcing extensions~\cite[pp.~139--178]{easton1970}, there exist models $M \models \mathsf{ZFC} + \forall p\,(V \neq \mathrm{HOD}(\{p\}))$, whose minimal coreflection $(M, {{sym:def-functor}}(M)) \models {{sym:gbc}} + \neg\mathsf{GC}$ leaves $\mathbf{Card} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Set}$ unsplit. (Bare $V \neq \mathrm{HOD}$ is insufficient: for a single Cohen real $c$ over $L$, $L[c] \models V \neq \mathrm{HOD}$ yet the parameter-definable well-order $<_{L[c]} \in {{sym:def-functor}}(L[c])$ still splits $\mathbf{Card} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Set}$.)
\end{inlineclaim}

nodes.statement: By Williams's Fixed-Set Universality Theorem (Williams 2018, Ch. 2-3 / Main Theorem), holding any countable model M |= ZFC completely rigid via id_M, the vertical fiber poset pi_Set^{-1}(M) of GBC-realizations (M, C) ordered by class inclusion embeds every countable partial order. Abstracting the underlying algebraic mechanism, given any partial order (P, <=) and an IndependentClassFamily F over a fixed base M, the principal-ideal map p |-> cl(down p) defines a strict OrderEmbedding P >->o FixedSetFiber M holding base = M identically rigid; moreover, every Nat-indexed countable partial order embeds into a Boolean-closed finitely-supported fiber over Nat x Bool.
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Vertical fiber `π_Set⁻¹(M)` over a fixed set base `M`, ordered by class inclusion. -/
structure FixedSetFiber (M : Type) : Type 1 where
  /-- Predicative class collection over `M`. -/
  IsClass : (M → Prop) → Prop

/-- Fixed underlying set carrier `M` (identically rigid across the fiber). -/
@[reducible] def FixedSetFiber.base {M : Type} (_ : FixedSetFiber M) : Type := M

/-- Inclusion preorder on `FixedSetFiber M` (axiom-free). -/
instance FixedSetFiber.instPreorder (M : Type) : Preorder (FixedSetFiber M) where
  le C₁ C₂ := ∀ X, C₁.IsClass X → C₂.IsClass X
  lt C₁ C₂ := (∀ X, C₁.IsClass X → C₂.IsClass X) ∧ ¬ (∀ X, C₂.IsClass X → C₁.IsClass X)
  le_refl _ _ h := h; le_trans _ _ _ h12 h23 X h := h23 X (h12 X h)
  lt_iff_le_not_ge _ _ := Iff.rfl

/-- Algebraically independent `P`-indexed family of classes with monotone closure `cl`. -/
structure IndependentClassFamily (M P : Type) [PartialOrder P] : Type 1 where
  /-- Generator family, monotone closure `cl`, membership, and algebraic independence. -/
  gen : P → (M → Prop)
  cl : (P → Prop) → (M → Prop) → Prop
  cl_mono : ∀ {S₁ S₂ : P → Prop}, (∀ q, S₁ q → S₂ q) → ∀ X, cl S₁ X → cl S₂ X
  gen_mem : ∀ S p, S p → cl S (gen p)
  independent : ∀ S p, cl S (gen p) → S p

/-- Principal-ideal fiber point `C_{↓p} ∈ π_Set⁻¹(M)`. -/
@[reducible] def principalIdealFiber {M P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (F : IndependentClassFamily M P) (p : P) : FixedSetFiber M where
  IsClass := F.cl (fun q ↦ q ≤ p)

/-- Strict `OrderEmbedding` `(P, ≤) ↪o FixedSetFiber M` via principal ideals `p ↦ C_{↓p}`. -/
def principalIdealEmbedding {M P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (F : IndependentClassFamily M P) : P ↪o FixedSetFiber M where
  toFun := principalIdealFiber F
  inj' a b h := by
    have h1 : (principalIdealFiber F a).IsClass (F.gen a) := F.gen_mem _ a le_rfl
    have h2 : (principalIdealFiber F b).IsClass (F.gen b) := F.gen_mem _ b le_rfl
    have hab : a ≤ b :=
      F.independent _ a (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun X ↦ X.IsClass (F.gen a)) h) h1)
    have hba : b ≤ a :=
      F.independent _ b (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun X ↦ X.IsClass (F.gen b)) h) h2)
    exact le_antisymm hab hba
  map_rel_iff' := fun {a b} ↦
    ⟨fun h ↦ F.independent _ a (h (F.gen a) (F.gen_mem _ a le_rfl)),
     fun hab X hX ↦ F.cl_mono (fun _ hqa ↦ le_trans hqa hab) X hX⟩

/-- Base rigidity: every embedded kaleidoscope point leaves the set floor `M` identical. -/
theorem principalIdealEmbedding_base_rigid {M P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (F : IndependentClassFamily M P) (p : P) : (principalIdealEmbedding F p).base = M := rfl

private theorem list_mem_of_not_forall_ne {P : Type} (e : P → Nat) (p : P) :
    ∀ L : List P, (¬ ∀ r ∈ L, e r ≠ e p) → ∃ r ∈ L, e r = e p
  | [], h => False.elim (h (fun _ hr ↦ by cases hr))
  | a :: tl, h => by
    by_cases hap : e a = e p
    · exact ⟨a, List.Mem.head tl, hap⟩
    · have htl : ¬ ∀ r ∈ tl, e r ≠ e p := fun hAll ↦ h fun r hr ↦ by
        cases hr with | head => exact hap | tail _ hm => exact hAll r hm
      rcases list_mem_of_not_forall_ne e p tl htl with ⟨r, hr, heq⟩
      exact ⟨r, List.Mem.tail a hr, heq⟩

/-- Concrete Boolean-closed independent column family over `ℕ × Bool` for any countable poset. -/
@[reducible] def countableColumnFamily {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] (e : P → Nat)
    (he : Function.Injective e) : IndependentClassFamily (Nat × Bool) P where
  gen p x := x.1 = e p ∧ x.2 = true
  cl S C := ∃ L : List P, (∀ r ∈ L, S r) ∧
    ∀ n, (∀ r ∈ L, e r ≠ n) → (C (n, false) ↔ C (n, true))
  cl_mono hS _ hC := let ⟨L, hL, hC⟩ := hC; ⟨L, fun r hr ↦ hS r (hL r hr), hC⟩
  gen_mem S p hp :=
    ⟨[p], (fun r hr ↦ by cases hr with | head => exact hp | tail _ h => cases h),
     fun n hn ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h.2,
       fun h ↦ False.elim (hn p (List.Mem.head []) h.1.symm)⟩⟩
  independent S p hC := by
    rcases hC with ⟨L, hL, hC⟩
    have hNotAll : ¬ ∀ r ∈ L, e r ≠ e p := fun hAll ↦
      Bool.noConfusion ((hC (e p) hAll).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩).2
    rcases list_mem_of_not_forall_ne e p L hNotAll with ⟨r, hr, heq⟩
    rw [← he heq]; exact hL r hr

private theorem mem_append_elim {α : Type} {a : α} :
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ : List α}, a ∈ L₁ ++ L₂ → a ∈ L₁ ∨ a ∈ L₂
  | [], _, h => Or.inr h
  | _ :: _, _, .head _ => Or.inl (List.Mem.head _)
  | _ :: _, _, .tail _ h => (mem_append_elim h).elim (fun h1 ↦ Or.inl (List.Mem.tail _ h1)) Or.inr
private theorem mem_append_l {α : Type} {a : α} :
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ : List α}, a ∈ L₁ → a ∈ L₁ ++ L₂
  | _ :: _, _, .head _ => List.Mem.head _
  | _ :: _, _, .tail _ h => List.Mem.tail _ (mem_append_l h)
private theorem mem_append_r {α : Type} {a : α} :
    ∀ (L₁ : List α) {L₂ : List α}, a ∈ L₂ → a ∈ L₁ ++ L₂
  | [], _, h => h
  | _ :: _, _, h => List.Mem.tail _ (mem_append_r _ h)

/-- Every generated fiber point of `countableColumnFamily` is closed under Boolean `¬` and `∩`. -/
theorem countableColumnFamily_bool_closed {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] (e : P → Nat)
    (he : Function.Injective e) (S : P → Prop) :
    (∀ C, (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S C →
      (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S (fun x ↦ ¬ C x)) ∧
    (∀ C₁ C₂, (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S C₁ →
      (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S C₂ →
      (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S (fun x ↦ C₁ x ∧ C₂ x)) := by
  refine ⟨fun C ⟨L, hL, hC⟩ ↦ ⟨L, hL, fun n hn ↦ not_congr (hC n hn)⟩,
    fun C₁ C₂ ⟨L₁, hL₁, hC₁⟩ ⟨L₂, hL₂, hC₂⟩ ↦ ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, fun r hr ↦ ?_, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · exact (mem_append_elim hr).elim (hL₁ r) (hL₂ r)
  · exact and_congr (hC₁ n fun r hr ↦ hn r (mem_append_l hr))
      (hC₂ n fun r hr ↦ hn r (mem_append_r L₁ hr))

/-- Every `ℕ`-indexed countable partial order strictly embeds into `FixedSetFiber (ℕ × Bool)`. -/
theorem countable_poset_embeds_fixed_set_fiber {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] (e : P → Nat)
    (he : Function.Injective e) :
    ∃ ι : P ↪o FixedSetFiber (Nat × Bool), ∀ p, (ι p).base = (Nat × Bool) :=
  ⟨principalIdealEmbedding (countableColumnFamily e he), fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

/-- **Independent-Generator Fiber Order-Embedding Theorem (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Combines general `IndependentClassFamily` principal-ideal embedding + base rigidity
    with the Boolean-closed countable partial-order realization. -/
theorem williams_independent_fiber_embedding :
    (∀ {M P : Type} [PartialOrder P] (_ : IndependentClassFamily M P),
      ∃ ι : P ↪o FixedSetFiber M, (∀ a b, ι a ≤ ι b ↔ a ≤ b) ∧ ∀ p, (ι p).base = M) ∧
    (∀ {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] (e : P → Nat) (he : Function.Injective e),
      (∃ ι : P ↪o FixedSetFiber (Nat × Bool), ∀ p, (ι p).base = (Nat × Bool)) ∧
      ∀ S, (∀ C, (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S C →
          (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S (fun x ↦ ¬ C x)) ∧
        (∀ C₁ C₂, (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S C₁ →
          (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S C₂ →
          (countableColumnFamily e he).cl S (fun x ↦ C₁ x ∧ C₂ x))) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
exact ⟨fun {_ _} _ F ↦
      ⟨principalIdealEmbedding F, fun a b ↦ (principalIdealEmbedding F).map_rel_iff,
       principalIdealEmbedding_base_rigid F⟩,
    fun e he ↦ ⟨countable_poset_embeds_fixed_set_fiber e he,
      countableColumnFamily_bool_closed e he⟩⟩

nodes.title: Class Forcing ETR_Ord vs. Full ETR Reflection Leak and Fujimoto CT^-[ZFC] Contrast

dual_pillars.purpose: Equivalence of Class Forcing Theorem with ETR_Ord over NBG and Con(NBG + ETR_Ord) in full ETR
L_in-conservative compositional truth CT^-[ZFC] vs. Tarskian reflection leak at ETR_omega

nodes.statement: By Gitman, Hamkins, Holy, Schlicht, and Williams (J. Symbolic Logic 85, 2020, Thm. 1.2, pp. 869-905; noting that Gitman et al. write GBC for NBG = GBC + GC), over NBG the Class Forcing Theorem (definability of the forcing relation and Truth Lemma for proper-class forcing) is equivalent to Elementary Transfinite Recursion of length Ord (ETR_Ord), whereas strictly stronger full ETR proves Con(NBG + ETR_Ord). Already at ETR_omega, Tarskian truth predicates relative to arbitrary class parameters prove Con(ZFC), breaking L_in-conservativity over ZFC (conservative only over T* := Th_{L_in}(NBG + ETR_Ord)), contrasting sharply with Fujimoto's (APAL 163, 2012, pp. 1484-1523) L_in-conservative compositional truth theory CT^-[ZFC] (which only exhibits countable model non-expandability).
nodes.tex:
\begin{inlineclaim}[Class Forcing {{sym:etr-ord}}, Full $\mathsf{ETR}$ Reflection, and Fujimoto's $\mathsf{CT}^-{[}\mathsf{ZFC}{]}$ Contrast]\label{ch02:claim:gitman-etr-ord-fujimoto-contrast}%
\uses{ch02:thm:williams-fixed-set-kaleidoscope}%
Gitman, Hamkins, Holy, Schlicht, and Williams~\cite[Thm.~1.2, pp.~869--905]{gitman2020} (explicitly noting that \cite{gitman2020} write ``$\mathsf{GBC}$'' for ${{sym:nbg}} = {{sym:gbc}} + \mathsf{GC}$; cf.~\cite{williams2018}) prove that over ${{sym:nbg}}$, the Class Forcing Theorem is equivalent to Elementary Transfinite Recursion of length $\mathrm{Ord}$ ({{sym:etr-ord}}), whereas strictly stronger full $\mathsf{ETR}$ along arbitrary class well-orderings proves $\mathrm{Con}({{sym:nbg}} + {{sym:etr-ord}})$. Constructing Tarskian truth predicates relative to arbitrary class parameters holds already at $\mathsf{ETR}_\omega$, which proves $\mathrm{Con}(\mathsf{ZFC})$ and triggers an $\mathcal{L}_\in$-reflection leak over $\mathsf{ZFC}$ (remaining $\mathcal{L}_\in$-conservative only over its own first-order trace $T^* := \mathrm{Th}_{\mathcal{L}_\in}({{sym:nbg}} + {{sym:etr-ord}})$)---contrasting sharply with Kentaro Fujimoto's~\cite[pp.~1484--1523]{fujimoto2012} $\mathcal{L}_\in$-conservative compositional truth theory $\mathsf{CT}^-[\mathsf{ZFC}]$, which exhibits countable model non-expandability without proving new $\mathcal{L}_\in$-sentences.
\end{inlineclaim}

nodes.title: Kelley-Morse Impredicative Comprehension and Freyd's Large-Limit / Kan Barrier

dual_pillars.purpose: Freyd's theorem blocking proper-class-indexed limits and internal large Kan extensions in Set
Second-order arithmetic comprehension ladder ACA_0 < ATR_0 < Pi^1_1-CA_0 < Z_2

nodes.statement: Impredicative Kelley-Morse class theory (KM, modeled by (V_kappa, V_{kappa+1}) for an inaccessible cardinal kappa, proving Con(NBG + ETR) and hence Con(NBG + ETR_Ord), and paralleling the classical second-order arithmetic climb ACA_0 < ATR_0 < Pi^1_1-CA_0 < Z_2 of Simpson 2009) calibrates full Pi^1_infty class comprehension over V. Nevertheless, by Freyd's product-collapse theorem (Mac Lane 1998, Ch. V, §2, Prop. 3, p. 114), even KM cannot endow Set with arbitrary proper-class-indexed limits, colimits, or unrestricted internal large Kan extensions without passing to a strictly larger Grothendieck universe V_lambda ni V_kappa.
nodes.tex:
\begin{inlineclaim}[Kelley--Morse {{sym:km}} Comprehension and Freyd's Large-Limit Barrier]\label{ch02:claim:kelley-morse-freyd-kan-barrier}%
\uses{ch02:claim:gitman-etr-ord-fujimoto-contrast}%
Mirroring Simpson's second-order arithmetic ladder $\mathrm{ACA}_0 \subsetneq \mathrm{ATR}_0 \subsetneq \Pi^1_1\text{-}\mathrm{CA}_0 \subsetneq \mathsf{Z}_2$~\cite[Chs.~I \&~VII]{simpson2009}, climbing to impredicative Kelley--Morse class theory ({{sym:km}})---modeled by $(V_\kappa, V_{\kappa+1})$ for an inaccessible cardinal $\kappa$, and proving $\mathrm{Con}({{sym:nbg}} + \mathsf{ETR})$ alongside $\mathrm{Con}({{sym:nbg}} + {{sym:etr-ord}})$~\cite{gitman2020}---supplies full $\Pi^1_\infty$ class comprehension over $V$. Yet by Freyd's product-collapse theorem~\cite[Ch.~V, \S 2, Prop.~3]{maclane1998}, no small category admitting products indexed by its own morphism size avoids collapsing to a preorder; hence even {{sym:km}} cannot endow $\mathbf{Set}$ with arbitrary proper-class-indexed limits or unrestricted internal large Kan extensions without stepping up to a larger Grothendieck universe $V_\lambda \ni V_\kappa$.
\end{inlineclaim}

\begin{theorem}[Volume~I Grounding Contract: Quantitative Base--Fiber Conservation and Leray Transgression]\label{vol1:thm:quantitative-conservation}%
Pinned read-only to Volume~I (\texttt{thm:quantitative-conservation}, \texttt{docs/categorical\_reverse\_mathematics.tex:1543}, together with \texttt{rem:leray-transgressive-cancellation} at line~\texttt{1588}, Lean witnesses \texttt{HomotopyCRM.\allowbreak{}commutator\_sl2\_f5\_eq\_top} and \texttt{HomotopyCRM.\allowbreak{}sl2\_f5\_leray\_transgression\_injective}, Zenodo DOI \texttt{10.5281/zenodo.24238086})~\cite{giraud1971}. Along any bounded geometric morphism $\gamma : \mathcal{E} \to \mathcal{S}$ and $A \in \mathbf{Ab}(\mathcal{E})$, Giraud's injective-free exact sequence
\[
  0 \longrightarrow H^1(\mathcal{S}; \gamma_* A) \xrightarrow{\;\gamma^*\;} H^1(\mathcal{E}; A) \xrightarrow{\;\beta\;} \Gamma_{\mathcal{S}}(R^1\gamma_* A) \xrightarrow{\;d_2\;} H^2(\mathcal{S}; \gamma_* A)
\]
partitions total torsor obstructions into base $H^1$ and $\ker(d_2)$, with transgressive cancellation into base $H^2$ witnessed by the central extension $1 \to \{\pm I\} \to \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_5) \to A_5 \to 1$.
\end{theorem}

nodes.tex:
Chapter~3 closes Part~I by pairing the vertical fiber calculus of Chapter~2 with the horizontal conservativity and base-change transgression analysis along {{sym:piset}}. Building on Volume~I's quantitative Giraud--Leray conservation sequence ({{ref:vol1:thm:quantitative-conservation}})~\cite{giraud1971} and Chapter~2's syntactic base-change adjunction ({{ref:ch02:prop:syntactic-conservative-pullback}}), Section~3.1 sharpens Makkai's equivalence-splitting calibration ({{ref:vol1:prop:large-equiv-splitting}})~\cite{makkai1996}: Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:anafunctor-vs-functorial-gc-splitting} proves axiom-free that saturated anafunctorial spans operate unconditionally inside {{sym:gbc}}, whereas functorial splittings of $\mathrm{skel} : \mathcal{S} \to {{sym:card-cat}}$ are bi-definably equivalent to Global Choice (differing by a unique vertical gauge torsor), and Proposition~\ref{ch03:prop:skeleton-quotient-choice-stratum} calibrates the jump from Amber equipollence quotients to Crimson representative extraction via \texttt{Quotient.out}.

Section~3.2 then dissects the set-theoretic membrane separating vertical harmlessness from horizontal leakage. Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:felgner-kappa-closed-membrane} isolates Foundation and Replacement inside Felgner's (1971) $\kappa$-closed forcing membrane~\cite{felgner1971}, whereas Proposition~\ref{ch03:prop:glazer-hartogs-scott-surjection} explains how {{sym:gbc0}} + $\mathsf{GC}$ activates Hartogs--Scott prewellorderings and \textbf{G4} Subclass Separation to refute Glazer's $\theta_{\mathrm{Glz}}$ ({{ref:vol1:thm:glazer-nonconservativity}})~\cite{glazer2023}. Claims~\ref{ch03:claim:mathias-gb0-nonconservative-over-mac} and~\ref{ch03:claim:felgner76-foundation-free-dc-ord-leak} lock down the two remaining boundaries: Mathias's theorem~\cite{mathias2001,cole1973,osius1974} showing that {{sym:gb0}} already leaks over $\Delta_0$-bounded $\mathsf{Mac} \simeq \mathsf{ETCS}$ prior to $\mathsf{GC}$, and Felgner's (1976) proof~\cite{felgner1976} that {{sym:nbg-noreg}} forces {{sym:dc-ord}} over {{sym:zfc-noreg}}.

Sections~3.3--3.4 unify these phenomena in the Lindenbaum/Stone transgression operator {{sym:dset}} and open leakage locus {{sym:uleak}}: Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:piset-transgression-exactness} proves that syntactic conservativity and pullback Cartesianness hold if and only if ${{sym:dset}}(\tau) = \bot$ (and vanish monotonically under base absorption), while Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:two-valve-transgression-dichotomy} resolves the exact $2 \times 2$ $(\mathrm{Replacement} \times \mathrm{Foundation})$ dichotomy across $\mathsf{ZFC}$, $\mathsf{ZC}$, {{sym:zfc-noreg}}, and $\mathsf{ZC}_{\neg\mathrm{Reg}}$, summarized in Table~\ref{ch03:tab:piset-four-quadrant-ledger} and opening onto Problem~\ref{ch03:prob:morleyized-classifying-topos-transgression}.

nodes.statement: Over any equipollence groupoid projection skel : S -> C surjective up to internal equivalences Eqv s1 s2, (1) Makkai's relational/anafunctor inverse span R(c, s) := (skel s = c) is unconditionally total, equipollence-saturated, single-orbit fiber-transitive, and base-coherent with zero choice hypothesis (staying inside GBC); (2) Functorial splitting (sec : C -> S with coherent transport eta : Eqv (sec (skel s)) s) is bi-definably equivalent to uniform fiberwise Global Choice; and (3) Any two splittings differ by a unique vertical gauge torsor of fiberwise automorphisms.
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Abstract groupoid / equipollence projection `skel : S → C` surjective onto `C` up to
    internal groupoid equivalences `Eqv s₁ s₂`. -/
structure EquipollenceSystem.{u, v} : Type (max (u + 1) (v + 1)) where
  /-- Objects, skeletal cardinal base, projection `skel`, and groupoid equivalences `Eqv`. -/
  S : Type u
  C : Type v
  skel : S → C
  Eqv : S → S → Type u
  refl : ∀ s, Eqv s s
  symm : ∀ {s₁ s₂}, Eqv s₁ s₂ → Eqv s₂ s₁
  trans : ∀ {s₁ s₂ s₃}, Eqv s₁ s₂ → Eqv s₂ s₃ → Eqv s₁ s₃
  trans_refl_left : ∀ {s₁ s₂} (e : Eqv s₁ s₂), trans (refl s₁) e = e
  trans_refl_right : ∀ {s₁ s₂} (e : Eqv s₁ s₂), trans e (refl s₂) = e
  trans_assoc : ∀ {s₁ s₂ s₃ s₄} (e₁ : Eqv s₁ s₂) (e₂ : Eqv s₂ s₃) (e₃ : Eqv s₃ s₄),
    trans (trans e₁ e₂) e₃ = trans e₁ (trans e₂ e₃)
  trans_symm_left : ∀ {s₁ s₂} (e : Eqv s₁ s₂), trans (symm e) e = refl s₂
  trans_symm_right : ∀ {s₁ s₂} (e : Eqv s₁ s₂), trans e (symm e) = refl s₁
  skel_surj : ∀ c : C, ∃ s : S, skel s = c
  skel_eq_iff_eqv : ∀ s₁ s₂ : S, skel s₁ = skel s₂ ↔ Nonempty (Eqv s₁ s₂)

/-- Makkai relational / anafunctor inverse span `R(c, s) := (skel s = c)`. -/
def AnafunctorInvSpan.{u, v} (E : EquipollenceSystem.{u, v}) (c : E.C) (s : E.S) : Prop :=
  E.skel s = c

/-- Totality, equipollence-saturation, single-orbit fiber transitivity, and base coherence of
    the anafunctor inverse span `R(c, s) := (skel s = c)`. -/
def IsSaturatedAnafunctorSpan.{u, v} (E : EquipollenceSystem.{u, v}) : Prop :=
  (∀ c : E.C, ∃ s : E.S, AnafunctorInvSpan E c s) ∧
  (∀ c s₁ s₂, AnafunctorInvSpan E c s₁ → Nonempty (E.Eqv s₁ s₂) → AnafunctorInvSpan E c s₂) ∧
  (∀ c s₁ s₂, AnafunctorInvSpan E c s₁ → AnafunctorInvSpan E c s₂ → Nonempty (E.Eqv s₁ s₂)) ∧
  (∀ c₁ c₂ s, AnafunctorInvSpan E c₁ s → AnafunctorInvSpan E c₂ s → c₁ = c₂)

/-- Functorial splitting of `skel : S → C`: a section `sec : C → S` together with coherent
    transport equivalences `eta s : Eqv (sec (skel s)) s` and induced groupoid action `map`. -/
structure FunctorialSplitting.{u, v} (E : EquipollenceSystem.{u, v}) : Type (max u v) where
  /-- Object section `sec : C → S`, section identity, coherent transport `eta`, and functor map. -/
  sec : E.C → E.S
  skel_sec : ∀ c : E.C, E.skel (sec c) = c
  eta : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv (sec (E.skel s)) s
  map : ∀ {s₁ s₂ : E.S}, E.Eqv s₁ s₂ → E.Eqv (sec (E.skel s₁)) (sec (E.skel s₂))
  map_id : ∀ s : E.S, map (E.refl s) = E.refl (sec (E.skel s))
  map_comp : ∀ {s₁ s₂ s₃ : E.S} (f : E.Eqv s₁ s₂) (g : E.Eqv s₂ s₃),
    map (E.trans f g) = E.trans (map f) (map g)
  naturality : ∀ {s₁ s₂ : E.S} (f : E.Eqv s₁ s₂),
    E.trans (map f) (eta s₂) = E.trans (eta s₁) f

/-- Uniform Global Choice selector across all `skel`-fibers and equipollence-hom fibers. -/
structure UniformFiberChoice.{u, v} (E : EquipollenceSystem.{u, v}) : Type (max u v) where
  /-- Uniform object selector on each `skel`-fiber and uniform equipollence selector. -/
  pickObj : ∀ c : E.C, { s : E.S // E.skel s = c }
  pickEqv : ∀ s₁ s₂ : E.S, E.skel s₁ = E.skel s₂ → E.Eqv s₁ s₂

/-- Vertical gauge transformation between two functorial splittings `F₁, F₂`: a fiberwise section
    isomorphism `g c : Eqv (F₁.sec c) (F₂.sec c)` coupled to fiberwise automorphisms `v s`. -/
def IsVerticalGaugeTorsor.{u, v} {E : EquipollenceSystem.{u, v}}
    (F₁ F₂ : FunctorialSplitting E) (g : ∀ c : E.C, E.Eqv (F₁.sec c) (F₂.sec c))
    (v : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : E.S, E.trans (g (E.skel s)) (F₂.eta s) = E.trans (F₁.eta s) (v s)

/-- **Anafunctoriality vs. Functorial Global Choice Splitting (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    (1) `R(c, s) := (skel s = c)` is unconditionally total and saturated with zero choice;
    (2) Functorial splitting is bi-definably equivalent to uniform fiberwise Global Choice;
    (3) Any two splittings differ by a unique vertical gauge torsor of fiberwise automorphisms. -/
theorem anafunctor_vs_functorial_gc_splitting.{u, v} (E : EquipollenceSystem.{u, v}) :
    IsSaturatedAnafunctorSpan E ∧
    (Nonempty (FunctorialSplitting E) ↔ Nonempty (UniformFiberChoice E)) ∧
    (∀ F₁ F₂ : FunctorialSplitting E,
      ∃ g : ∀ c : E.C, E.Eqv (F₁.sec c) (F₂.sec c),
        ∃ v : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s,
          IsVerticalGaugeTorsor F₁ F₂ g v ∧
          ∀ w : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s, IsVerticalGaugeTorsor F₁ F₂ g w → ∀ s, w s = v s) ∧
    (∀ (F₁ F₂ : FunctorialSplitting E) (hsec : F₁.sec = F₂.sec),
      ∃ v : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s,
        (∀ s, E.trans (F₁.eta s) (v s) = hsec ▸ F₂.eta s) ∧
        ∀ w : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s,
          (∀ s, E.trans (F₁.eta s) (w s) = hsec ▸ F₂.eta s) → ∀ s, w s = v s) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨E.skel_surj, fun c s₁ s₂ h₁ he ↦ ?_, fun c s₁ s₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_, fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact ((E.skel_eq_iff_eqv s₁ s₂).mpr he).symm.trans h₁
    · exact (E.skel_eq_iff_eqv s₁ s₂).mp (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
    · exact h₁.symm.trans h₂
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨F⟩
      refine ⟨{
        pickObj := fun c ↦ ⟨F.sec c, F.skel_sec c⟩
        pickEqv := fun s₁ s₂ h ↦ E.trans (E.symm (F.eta s₁)) (h ▸ F.eta s₂)
      }⟩
    · rintro ⟨G⟩
      let sec : E.C → E.S := fun c ↦ (G.pickObj c).1
      let skel_sec : ∀ c, E.skel (sec c) = c := fun c ↦ (G.pickObj c).2
      let eta : ∀ s, E.Eqv (sec (E.skel s)) s := fun s ↦ G.pickEqv (sec (E.skel s)) s (skel_sec _)
      let map : ∀ {s₁ s₂ : E.S}, E.Eqv s₁ s₂ → E.Eqv (sec (E.skel s₁)) (sec (E.skel s₂)) :=
        fun {s₁ s₂} f ↦ E.trans (eta s₁) (E.trans f (E.symm (eta s₂)))
      refine ⟨{
        sec := sec
        skel_sec := skel_sec
        eta := eta
        map := map
        map_id := fun s ↦ by
          change E.trans (eta s) (E.trans (E.refl s) (E.symm (eta s))) = E.refl (sec (E.skel s))
          rw [E.trans_refl_left, E.trans_symm_right]
        map_comp := fun {s₁ s₂ s₃} f g ↦ by
          change E.trans (eta s₁) (E.trans (E.trans f g) (E.symm (eta s₃))) =
            E.trans (E.trans (eta s₁) (E.trans f (E.symm (eta s₂))))
              (E.trans (eta s₂) (E.trans g (E.symm (eta s₃))))
          rw [E.trans_assoc (eta s₁) (E.trans f (E.symm (eta s₂))),
            E.trans_assoc f (E.symm (eta s₂)),
            ← E.trans_assoc (E.symm (eta s₂)) (eta s₂),
            E.trans_symm_left, E.trans_refl_left, E.trans_assoc f g]
        naturality := fun {s₁ s₂} f ↦ by
          change E.trans (E.trans (eta s₁) (E.trans f (E.symm (eta s₂)))) (eta s₂) =
            E.trans (eta s₁) f
          rw [E.trans_assoc (eta s₁), E.trans_assoc f, E.trans_symm_left, E.trans_refl_right]
      }⟩

    let g : ∀ c : E.C, E.Eqv (F₁.sec c) (F₂.sec c) :=
      fun c ↦ Eq.rec (motive := fun c' _ ↦ E.Eqv (F₁.sec c') (F₂.sec c))
        (F₁.eta (F₂.sec c)) (F₂.skel_sec c)
    let v : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s :=
      fun s ↦ E.trans (E.symm (F₁.eta s)) (E.trans (g (E.skel s)) (F₂.eta s))
    refine ⟨g, v, fun s ↦ ?_, fun w hw s ↦ ?_⟩
    · change E.trans (g (E.skel s)) (F₂.eta s) =
        E.trans (F₁.eta s) (E.trans (E.symm (F₁.eta s)) (E.trans (g (E.skel s)) (F₂.eta s)))
      rw [← E.trans_assoc, E.trans_symm_right, E.trans_refl_left]
    · calc
        w s = E.trans (E.refl s) (w s) := (E.trans_refl_left (w s)).symm

        _ = E.trans (E.symm (F₁.eta s)) (E.trans (F₁.eta s) (w s)) := E.trans_assoc _ _ _

    cases F₂ with | mk sec₂ skel₂ eta₂ map₂ mid₂ mcomp₂ nat₂ =>

    subst hsec
    let v : ∀ s : E.S, E.Eqv s s := fun s ↦ E.trans (E.symm (eta₁ s)) (eta₂ s)

        w s = E.trans (E.refl s) (w s) := (E.trans_refl_left (w s)).symm

nodes.statement: On Type u, the equipollence quotient EquipollenceQuot := Quotient EquivSetoid projects every type canonically to its cardinal class equipollenceClass alpha in the Amber quotient stratum ([propext, Quot.sound]) with choice-free surjectivity, whereas extracting a global representative section rep : EquipollenceQuot -> Type u satisfying equipollenceClass (rep q) = q together with uniform equivalences alpha ~= rep (equipollenceClass alpha) calibrates the Crimson Classical.choice stratum (previewing Chapter 9 Obstruction 2b).
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Equipollence setoid on `Type u`: `α ≈ β ↔ Nonempty (α ≃ β)`. -/
def EquivSetoid.{u} : Setoid (Type u) where
  r α β := Nonempty (α ≃ β)
  iseqv :=
    { refl := fun α ↦ ⟨Equiv.refl α⟩
      symm := fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ⟨e.symm⟩
      trans := fun ⟨e₁⟩ ⟨e₂⟩ ↦ ⟨e₁.trans e₂⟩ }

/-- Cardinality / equipollence quotient `EquipollenceQuot := Quotient EquivSetoid` on `Type u`. -/
def EquipollenceQuot.{u} : Type (u + 1) := Quotient EquivSetoid.{u}

/-- Canonical projection sending each type `α : Type u` to its equipollence class. -/
def equipollenceClass.{u} (α : Type u) : EquipollenceQuot.{u} := Quotient.mk EquivSetoid.{u} α

/-- Amber quotient soundness (`[propext, Quot.sound]` without choice): two types share the same
    equipollence class iff they are equipollent. -/
theorem equipollenceClass_eq_iff.{u} (α β : Type u) :
    equipollenceClass α = equipollenceClass β ↔ Nonempty (α ≃ β) :=
  Quotient.eq

/-- Choice-free surjectivity of the equipollence quotient projection. -/
theorem equipollenceClass_surjective.{u} :
    ∀ q : EquipollenceQuot.{u}, ∃ α : Type u, equipollenceClass α = q :=
  fun q ↦ Quotient.ind (motive := fun q' ↦ ∃ α : Type u, equipollenceClass α = q')
    (fun α ↦ ⟨α, rfl⟩) q

/-- Existence of a global representative map `rep : EquipollenceQuot → Type u` splitting `mk`. -/
def HasGlobalEquipollenceRep.{u} : Prop :=
  ∃ rep : EquipollenceQuot.{u} → Type u, ∀ q : EquipollenceQuot.{u}, equipollenceClass (rep q) = q

/-- **Skeleton Quotient Choice Stratum (Crimson):**
    (1) `equipollenceClass` projects every type canonically to `EquipollenceQuot` with Amber
        soundness (`[propext, Quot.sound]`);
    (2) Extracting a global representative section `rep : EquipollenceQuot → Type u` with
        `∀ q, equipollenceClass (rep q) = q` and uniform equivalences `α ≃ rep [α]` inhabits the
        Crimson `Classical.choice` stratum (previewing Chapter 9 Obstruction 2b). -/
theorem skeleton_quotient_choice_stratum.{u} :
    (∀ α β : Type u, equipollenceClass α = equipollenceClass β ↔ Nonempty (α ≃ β)) ∧
    (∀ q : EquipollenceQuot.{u}, ∃ α : Type u, equipollenceClass α = q) ∧
    HasGlobalEquipollenceRep.{u} ∧
    ∃ rep : EquipollenceQuot.{u} → Type u,
      (∀ q : EquipollenceQuot.{u}, equipollenceClass (rep q) = q) ∧
      Nonempty (∀ α : Type u, α ≃ rep (equipollenceClass α)) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
let rep : EquipollenceQuot.{u} → Type u := Quotient.out
  have hrep : ∀ q : EquipollenceQuot.{u}, equipollenceClass (rep q) = q := Quotient.out_eq
  have hbij : Nonempty (∀ α : Type u, α ≃ rep (equipollenceClass α)) :=
    ⟨fun α ↦ Classical.choice ((equipollenceClass_eq_iff α (rep (equipollenceClass α))).mp
      (hrep (equipollenceClass α)).symm)⟩
  exact ⟨equipollenceClass_eq_iff, equipollenceClass_surjective, ⟨rep, hrep⟩, ⟨rep, hrep, hbij⟩⟩

nodes.statement: Over ZFC, NBG := GBC + GC is syntactically L_in-conservative over ZFC (Felgner 1971, Thm. 1, pp. 45-56). Specifically, Felgner's class forcing poset P of set-sized injective partial enumerations p : alpha >-> V relies on two load-bearing ground axioms: (1) Foundation (V = U_{alpha in Ord} V_alpha) so Easton/Felgner rank stages exhaust all sets, and (2) Replacement so every small kappa-indexed family of dense open conditions compresses into a single master extension, rendering P <kappa-distributive for every cardinal kappa and yielding zero new bounded subsets of any ground set.
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Abstract stratified class-forcing poset `(Cond, le)` over sets `SetObj`, rank stages `Rank`,
    and bounded subset names `Name`, isolating Foundation (`RankExhaustive`) and Replacement
    (`SmallDenseIntersectionClosed`) in Felgner's (1971) `κ`-closed membrane. -/
structure StratifiedForcingMembrane : Type 1 where
  /-- Set universe, rank stages, forcing conditions, names, membership, and forcing relations. -/
  SetObj : Type
  Rank : Type
  Cond : Type
  Name : Type
  mem : SetObj → SetObj → Prop
  inStage : SetObj → Rank → Prop
  le : Cond → Cond → Prop
  le_refl : ∀ p, le p p
  le_trans : ∀ {p q r}, le p q → le q r → le p r
  forcesMem : Cond → Name → SetObj → Prop
  forcesNotMem : Cond → Name → SetObj → Prop
  forcesMem_mono : ∀ {p q} {τ : Name} {x : SetObj}, le q p → forcesMem p τ x → forcesMem q τ x
  forcesNotMem_mono : ∀ {p q} {τ : Name} {x : SetObj},
    le q p → forcesNotMem p τ x → forcesNotMem q τ x
  forces_consistent : ∀ p τ x, ¬ (forcesMem p τ x ∧ forcesNotMem p τ x)
  decide_dense : ∀ p τ x, ∃ q, le q p ∧ (forcesMem q τ x ∨ forcesNotMem q τ x)
  ground_sep : ∀ (A : SetObj) (r : Rank), inStage A r →
    ∀ (p : Cond) (τ : Name),
      (∀ x, mem x A → forcesMem p τ x ∨ forcesNotMem p τ x) →
      ∃ B : SetObj, ∀ x, mem x B ↔ (mem x A ∧ forcesMem p τ x)

/-- Foundation hypothesis: every set object lies in a cumulative rank stage `V_α`. -/
def RankExhaustive (F : StratifiedForcingMembrane) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : F.SetObj, ∃ r : F.Rank, F.inStage A r

/-- Replacement + `<κ`-closure hypothesis: every rank-bounded set `A` compresses an `A`-indexed
    family of dense open condition classes into a single master condition `q ≤ p`. -/
def SmallDenseIntersectionClosed (F : StratifiedForcingMembrane) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : F.SetObj) (r : F.Rank), F.inStage A r →
    ∀ (D : F.SetObj → F.Cond → Prop),
      (∀ x, F.mem x A → ∀ p, ∃ q, F.le q p ∧ D x q) →
      (∀ x p q, F.le q p → D x p → D x q) →
      ∀ p, ∃ q, F.le q p ∧ ∀ x, F.mem x A → D x q

/-- Zero Bounded Subset Leak (`<κ`-distributivity): every name `τ` for a subset of `A` is forced
    below `p` to coincide with an existing ground-model set `B`. -/
def ZeroBoundedSubsetLeak (F : StratifiedForcingMembrane) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : F.SetObj) (p : F.Cond) (τ : F.Name),
    ∃ (q : F.Cond) (B : F.SetObj), F.le q p ∧
      ∀ x, F.mem x A →
        ((F.mem x B → F.forcesMem q τ x) ∧ (¬ F.mem x B → F.forcesNotMem q τ x))

/-- Concrete inhabited witness of `StratifiedForcingMembrane` over `Nat`-ranked subsets. -/
@[reducible] def natRankMembrane : StratifiedForcingMembrane where
  SetObj := Nat → Bool
  Rank := Nat
  Cond := Unit
  Name := Nat → Bool
  mem x A := A (if x 0 then 1 else 0) = true
  inStage _ _ := True
  le _ _ := True
  le_refl _ := trivial
  le_trans _ _ := trivial
  forcesMem _ τ x := τ (if x 0 then 1 else 0) = true
  forcesNotMem _ τ x := τ (if x 0 then 1 else 0) = false
  forcesMem_mono _ h := h
  forcesNotMem_mono _ h := h
  forces_consistent _ _ _ h := Bool.noConfusion (h.1.symm.trans h.2)
  decide_dense _ τ x :=
    ⟨(), trivial, by
      cases h : τ (if x 0 then 1 else 0)
      · exact Or.inr rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl⟩
  ground_sep A _ _ _ τ _ :=
    ⟨fun n ↦ A n && τ n, fun x ↦ by
      dsimp only
      cases hA : A (if x 0 then 1 else 0) <;> cases hτ : τ (if x 0 then 1 else 0)
      · exact ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h.1⟩
      · exact ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h.1⟩
      · exact ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h.2⟩
      · exact ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩⟩

/-- **Felgner `κ`-Closed Membrane Witness (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    In any `StratifiedForcingMembrane`, `RankExhaustive ∧ SmallDenseIntersectionClosed` implies
    `ZeroBoundedSubsetLeak`, and `natRankMembrane` concretely inhabits the hypotheses. -/
theorem felgner_kappa_closed_membrane :
    (∀ F : StratifiedForcingMembrane,
      RankExhaustive F → SmallDenseIntersectionClosed F → ZeroBoundedSubsetLeak F) ∧
    (RankExhaustive natRankMembrane ∧ SmallDenseIntersectionClosed natRankMembrane ∧
      ZeroBoundedSubsetLeak natRankMembrane) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
have hMain : ∀ F : StratifiedForcingMembrane,
      RankExhaustive F → SmallDenseIntersectionClosed F → ZeroBoundedSubsetLeak F := by
    intro F hReg hRep A p τ
    rcases hReg A with ⟨r, hr⟩
    let D : F.SetObj → F.Cond → Prop := fun x q ↦ F.forcesMem q τ x ∨ F.forcesNotMem q τ x
    have hDense : ∀ x, F.mem x A → ∀ p₀, ∃ q, F.le q p₀ ∧ D x q :=
      fun x _ p₀ ↦ F.decide_dense p₀ τ x
    have hOpen : ∀ x p₀ q₀, F.le q₀ p₀ → D x p₀ → D x q₀ := fun x _ _ hle hD ↦
      hD.elim (fun hm ↦ Or.inl (F.forcesMem_mono hle hm))
        (fun hnm ↦ Or.inr (F.forcesNotMem_mono hle hnm))
    rcases hRep A r hr D hDense hOpen p with ⟨q, hqp, hDec⟩
    rcases F.ground_sep A r hr q τ hDec with ⟨B, hB⟩
    refine ⟨q, B, hqp, fun x hx ↦ ⟨fun hBx ↦ ((hB x).mp hBx).2, fun hNBx ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    rcases hDec x hx with hm | hnm
    · exact False.elim (hNBx ((hB x).mpr ⟨hx, hm⟩))
    · exact hnm
  have hRegNat : RankExhaustive natRankMembrane := fun _ ↦ ⟨(0 : Nat), trivial⟩
  have hRepNat : SmallDenseIntersectionClosed natRankMembrane := fun A _ _ D hD _ _ ↦
    ⟨(), trivial, fun x hx ↦ let ⟨_, _, hdx⟩ := hD x hx (); hdx⟩
  exact ⟨hMain, hRegNat, hRepNat, hMain natRankMembrane hRegNat hRepNat⟩

nodes.statement: Over Replacement-free GB_0 + GC (without von Neumann ordinals above omega + omega), (1) global well-ordering induces an injective section W^+(A) >-> WO(A) splitting the canonical small-domain surjection WO(A) ->> W^+(A) from well-orderings of A <= P(A x A) onto the Hartogs/Scott prewellordering stage W^+(A) <= P^2(A x A); (2) over GBC_0 + GC, Global Choice selects uniform enumerations f_n : omega ->> X_n across Glazer's psi_fnd family, enabling G4 projection and Subclass Separation on P(omega x omega) x W_2 in S to manufacture a small partial surjection P(omega x omega) -> W_2 (equivalently P(omega) ->> W_2), refuting CH and Glazer's theta_Glz.
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Abstract Hartogs–Scott prewellordering stage `W^+(A)` over small well-orderings
    `WO(A) ⊆ P(A × A)` equipped with a global well-order representative selector. -/
structure HartogsPreWOSystem : Type 1 where
  /-- Small well-orderings `WO`, Hartogs–Scott stage `WPlus`, order type, and selector. -/
  WO : Type
  WPlus : Type
  ordType : WO → WPlus
  ordType_surj : ∀ w : WPlus, ∃ r : WO, ordType r = w
  globalSelect : ∀ w : WPlus, { r : WO // ordType r = w }

/-- Abstract Glazer separation system over `GBC₀ + GC`: class `A`, `ω`-indexed countable sets
    `X n`, separating relation `R` on `⋃_n X_n`, small target `W₂`, and class surjection `P₂`. -/
structure GlazerSeparationSystem : Type 1 where
  /-- Class `A`, stages `X n`, separating relation `R`, target `W₂`, and surjection `P₂`. -/
  A : Type
  X : Nat → Type
  R : (Σ n : Nat, X n) → A → Prop
  W2 : Type
  P2 : A → W2
  P2_surj : ∀ w : W2, ∃ a : A, P2 a = w
  R_separates : ∀ a₁ a₂ : A,
    (∀ (n : Nat) (x : X n), R ⟨n, x⟩ a₁ ↔ R ⟨n, x⟩ a₂) → a₁ = a₂

/-- Uniform Global Choice witness choosing surjections `enum n : Nat ↠ X n` for all `n`. -/
structure GlobalCountableEnum (G : GlazerSeparationSystem) : Type where
  /-- Simultaneous countable enumerations `ω ↠ X_n` across all `n : Nat`. -/
  enum : ∀ n : Nat, Nat → G.X n
  enum_surj : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : G.X n), ∃ m : Nat, enum n m = x

/-- Small-domain code in `P(ω × ω)` assigned to `a : G.A` via `E.enum`. -/
def glazerCode (G : GlazerSeparationSystem) (E : GlobalCountableEnum G) (a : G.A) :
    Nat × Nat → Prop :=
  fun mn ↦ G.R ⟨mn.2, E.enum mn.2 mn.1⟩ a

/-- G4-projected small-set graph `Φ ⊆ P(ω × ω) × W₂` carved out by Subclass Separation. -/
def glazerSmallGraph (G : GlazerSeparationSystem) (E : GlobalCountableEnum G)
    (S : Nat × Nat → Prop) (w : G.W2) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : G.A, (∀ mn, S mn ↔ glazerCode G E a mn) ∧ G.P2 a = w

/-- **Algebraic Hartogs–Scott & Glazer Small-Domain Surjection Witness (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    (1) Over `HartogsPreWOSystem`, `globalSelect` splits `WO ↠ WPlus` via an injective section;
    (2) Over `GlazerSeparationSystem` + `GlobalCountableEnum`, `glazerCode` separates elements of
        `A` inside `P(ω × ω)`, making `glazerSmallGraph` a single-valued small-domain partial
        surjection `P(ω × ω) ⇀ W₂` (refuting `CH` when `W₂` has order type `ω₂`). -/
theorem glazer_hartogs_scott_surjection :
    (∀ H : HartogsPreWOSystem,
      ∃ s : H.WPlus → H.WO,
        (∀ w, H.ordType (s w) = w) ∧
        (∀ w₁ w₂, s w₁ = s w₂ → w₁ = w₂) ∧
        (∀ w, ∃ r : H.WO, H.ordType r = w)) ∧
    (∀ (G : GlazerSeparationSystem) (E : GlobalCountableEnum G),
      (∀ a₁ a₂ : G.A, (∀ mn, glazerCode G E a₁ mn ↔ glazerCode G E a₂ mn) → a₁ = a₂) ∧
      (∀ (S : Nat × Nat → Prop) (w₁ w₂ : G.W2),
        glazerSmallGraph G E S w₁ → glazerSmallGraph G E S w₂ → w₁ = w₂) ∧
      (∀ w : G.W2, ∃ S : Nat × Nat → Prop, glazerSmallGraph G E S w)) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
refine ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨fun w ↦ (H.globalSelect w).1, fun w ↦ (H.globalSelect w).2,
      fun w₁ w₂ heq ↦ ?_, H.ordType_surj⟩,
    fun G E ↦ ?_⟩
  · calc
      w₁ = H.ordType (H.globalSelect w₁).1 := (H.globalSelect w₁).2.symm
      _ = H.ordType (H.globalSelect w₂).1 := congrArg H.ordType heq
      _ = w₂ := (H.globalSelect w₂).2
  · have hInj : ∀ a₁ a₂ : G.A,
        (∀ mn, glazerCode G E a₁ mn ↔ glazerCode G E a₂ mn) → a₁ = a₂ := by
      intro a₁ a₂ hcode
      refine G.R_separates a₁ a₂ fun n x ↦ ?_
      rcases E.enum_surj n x with ⟨m, rfl⟩
      exact hcode (m, n)
    refine ⟨hInj, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro S w₁ w₂ ⟨a₁, hS₁, hw₁⟩ ⟨a₂, hS₂, hw₂⟩
      have ha : a₁ = a₂ := hInj a₁ a₂ fun mn ↦ (hS₁ mn).symm.trans (hS₂ mn)
      exact hw₁.symm.trans ((congrArg G.P2 ha).trans hw₂)
    · intro w
      rcases G.P2_surj w with ⟨a, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨glazerCode G E a, a, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl, rfl⟩

nodes.statement: By the Cole-Mitchell-Osius bi-interpretation (Cole 1973, pp. 351-399; Osius 1974, §§3-5, pp. 79-119), Lawvere's ETCS is bi-interpretable with Delta_0-bounded Mac Lane set theory (Mac), not full Zermelo ZC. nodes.tex:
\begin{inlineclaim}[Mathias's Boundary: Unbounded {{sym:gb0}} Separation Over $\mathsf{Mac} \simeq \mathsf{ETCS}$]\label{ch03:claim:mathias-gb0-nonconservative-over-mac}%
\uses{vol1:thm:glazer-nonconservativity,ch03:prop:glazer-hartogs-scott-surjection}%
By the Cole--Mitchell--Osius equivalence~\cite{cole1973,osius1974}, Lawvere's $\mathsf{ETCS}$ is bi-interpretable with $\Delta_0$-bounded Mac~Lane set theory ($\mathsf{Mac}$), rather than full Zermelo set theory $\mathsf{ZC}$. As Mathias proved~\cite[\S\S 3--6, pp.~142--198]{mathias2001}, adjoining {{sym:gb0}}'s unbounded first-order Subclass Separation already breaks $\mathcal{L}_\in$-conservativity over $\mathsf{Mac}$ (and increases consistency strength strictly above $\mathsf{Mac} \simeq \mathsf{ETCS}$) \emph{prior} to adjoining Global Choice $\mathsf{GC}$---scoping the pure $\mathsf{GC}$ horizontal transgression of Theorem~\ref{vol1:thm:glazer-nonconservativity} and Proposition~\ref{ch03:prop:glazer-hartogs-scott-surjection} strictly to full-Separation $\mathsf{ZC}$.
\end{inlineclaim}

nodes.title: Lindenbaum-Stone Transgression Operator d_Set and Syntactic Pullback Exactness

dual_pillars.purpose: Axiom-free Emerald Lean 4 proof of d_Set exactness, syntactic pullback equivalence, and base-strengthening absorption
Pinned Volume I Leray transgression d_2 baseline

nodes.statement: Over any two-sorted syntactic base-class extension system (SetTh, ClsTh, Def_syn, Tr_set) with Def_syn -| Tr_set and Tr_set(Def_syn(T)) <= T, define the Horizontal Leakage / Transgression Operator d_Set(T, tau) := Tr_set(Def_syn(T) sup tau) (and open leakage locus U_leak(T, tau) := {X <= d_Set(T, tau) | not (X <= T)}). Then: (1) Exactness Criterion: Def_syn(T) sup tau is L_in-conservative over T iff d_Set(T, tau) = bot_T (equivalently U_leak(T, tau) = empty); (2) Pullback Cartesianness Equivalence: d_Set(T_0, tau) = bot_{T_0} iff every syntactic base-change square along T_0 <= T_1 is a genuine pullback against minimal expansions Def_syn(X); (3) Base-Strengthening Absorption: strengthening T_0 <= T_1 to absorb d_Set(T_0, tau) absorbs U_leak(T_0, tau) and forces d_Set(T_1, tau) = bot_{T_1} under trace-absorption stability (such as T_1 |- Rep /\ Reg).
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Syntactic class extension `Def_syn(T) ⊔ τ` over a base theory `T` in `SyntacticClassSystem`. -/
def classExt (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem) (T : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T) : Sys.ClsTh.T :=
  Sys.ClsTh.sup (Sys.defSyn T) τ

/-- Horizontal Leakage / Transgression Operator `d_Set(T, τ) := Tr_set(Def_syn(T) ⊔ τ)`,
    evaluated modulo the base floor `T` in the Lindenbaum slice `[T, ⊤]`. -/
def dSet (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem) (T : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T) : Sys.SetTh.T :=
  Sys.traceSet (classExt Sys T τ)

/-- Vanishing criterion `d_Set(T, τ) = ⊥_T`: every `L_∈`-consequence of `Def_syn(T) ⊔ τ` is
    already entailed by `T`. -/
def dSetEqBot (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem) (T : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T) : Prop :=
  ∀ X : Sys.SetTh.T, Sys.SetTh.le X (dSet Sys T τ) → Sys.SetTh.le X T

/-- Open leakage locus `U_leak(T, τ)` in the Lindenbaum/Stone frame of `T`: first-order set
    theories `X ≤ Tr_set(Def_syn(T) ⊔ τ)` strictly exceeding `T`. -/
def ULeak (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem) (T : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T) : Sys.SetTh.T → Prop :=
  fun X ↦ Sys.SetTh.le X (dSet Sys T τ) ∧ ¬ Sys.SetTh.le X T

/-- Syntactic base-change pullback property along `T₀ ≤ T₁` against minimal expansions. -/
def IsSyntacticBaseChangePullback (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem)
    (T₀ T₁ : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T) : Prop :=
  ∀ X : Sys.SetTh.T,
    (Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (classExt Sys T₀ τ) ∧
      Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₁)) ↔
    Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₀)

/-- **Horizontal Transgression Exactness Theorem (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Wired to Chapter 2's `syntactic_conservative_pullback`, proves:
    (1) Exactness: `IsConservativeExt Sys (classExt Sys T τ) T ↔ dSetEqBot Sys T τ`
        (and vanishing kills `ULeak`);
    (2) Pullback Cartesianness Equivalence: `dSetEqBot Sys T₀ τ` holds iff every base-change
        square along `T₀ ≤ T₁` is a genuine pullback against `Def_syn(X)`;
    (3) Base-Strengthening Absorption: strengthening `T₀ ≤ T₁` to absorb `dSet Sys T₀ τ`
        absorbs all of `ULeak Sys T₀ τ`, and kills `dSetEqBot Sys T₁ τ` whenever `T₁` is
        trace-absorption-stable (`dSet Sys T₁ τ ≤ T₁ ⊔ dSet Sys T₀ τ`). -/
theorem piset_transgression_exactness (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem) :
    (∀ (T : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T),
      (IsConservativeExt Sys (classExt Sys T τ) T ↔ dSetEqBot Sys T τ) ∧
      (dSetEqBot Sys T τ → ∀ X, ¬ ULeak Sys T τ X)) ∧
    (∀ (T₀ : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T),
      dSetEqBot Sys T₀ τ ↔
        ∀ T₁ : Sys.SetTh.T, Sys.SetTh.le T₀ T₁ → IsSyntacticBaseChangePullback Sys T₀ T₁ τ) ∧
    (∀ (T₀ T₁ : Sys.SetTh.T) (τ : Sys.ClsTh.T),
      Sys.SetTh.le T₀ T₁ → Sys.SetTh.le (dSet Sys T₀ τ) T₁ →
      (∀ X, ULeak Sys T₀ τ X → Sys.SetTh.le X T₁) ∧
      (Sys.SetTh.le (dSet Sys T₁ τ) (Sys.SetTh.sup T₁ (dSet Sys T₀ τ)) →
        dSetEqBot Sys T₁ τ ∧ ∀ X, ¬ ULeak Sys T₁ τ X)) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
have hBaseLeDSet : ∀ T τ, Sys.SetTh.le T (dSet Sys T τ) :=
    fun T τ ↦ (Sys.defSyn_le_iff T (classExt Sys T τ)).mp (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_left _ _)
  have hExact : ∀ T τ, IsConservativeExt Sys (classExt Sys T τ) T ↔ dSetEqBot Sys T τ := by
    intro T τ
    constructor
    · intro hCons X hX
      exact Sys.SetTh.le_trans hX hCons.1
    · intro hBot
      exact ⟨hBot (dSet Sys T τ) (Sys.SetTh.le_refl _), hBaseLeDSet T τ⟩
  refine ⟨fun T τ ↦ ⟨hExact T τ, fun hBot X hU ↦ hU.2 (hBot X hU.1)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro T₀ τ
    constructor
    · intro hBot T₁ hT
      have hCons : IsConservativeExt Sys (classExt Sys T₀ τ) T₀ := (hExact T₀ τ).mpr hBot
      have hPush : Sys.ClsTh.Equiv (classExt Sys T₁ τ)
          (Sys.ClsTh.sup (Sys.defSyn T₁) (classExt Sys T₀ τ)) :=
        ⟨Sys.ClsTh.sup_le (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_left _ _)
            (Sys.ClsTh.le_trans (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_right _ _) (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_right _ _)),
          Sys.ClsTh.sup_le (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_left _ _)
            (Sys.ClsTh.sup_le (Sys.ClsTh.le_trans (Sys.defSyn_mono hT) (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_left _ _))
              (Sys.ClsTh.le_sup_right _ _))⟩
      exact (syntactic_conservative_pullback Sys T₀ T₁ (classExt Sys T₀ τ)
        (classExt Sys T₁ τ) hT hCons hPush).2.1
    · intro hPB X hX
      have hPB' := hPB (dSet Sys T₀ τ) (hBaseLeDSet T₀ τ) X
      have hLeft : Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (classExt Sys T₀ τ) :=
        (Sys.defSyn_le_iff X (classExt Sys T₀ τ)).mpr hX
      have hRight : Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn (dSet Sys T₀ τ)) :=
        Sys.defSyn_mono hX
      have hDefT0 : Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₀) := hPB'.mp ⟨hLeft, hRight⟩
      exact Sys.SetTh.le_trans
        ((Sys.defSyn_le_iff X (Sys.defSyn T₀)).mp hDefT0) (Sys.defSyn_cons T₀)
  · intro T₀ T₁ τ _ hAbs
    refine ⟨fun X hU ↦ Sys.SetTh.le_trans hU.1 hAbs, fun hStab ↦ ?_⟩
    have hBot1 : dSetEqBot Sys T₁ τ := fun X hX ↦
      Sys.SetTh.le_trans hX
        (Sys.SetTh.le_trans hStab (Sys.SetTh.sup_le (Sys.SetTh.le_refl T₁) hAbs))
    exact ⟨hBot1, fun X hU ↦ hU.2 (hBot1 X hU.1)⟩

nodes.tex:
\begin{theorem}[Two-Valve Base--Fiber Transgression Dichotomy]\label{ch03:thm:two-valve-transgression-dichotomy}%
\uses{ch03:thm:felgner-kappa-closed-membrane,ch03:prop:glazer-hartogs-scott-surjection,ch03:claim:mathias-gb0-nonconservative-over-mac,ch03:claim:felgner76-foundation-free-dc-ord-leak,ch03:thm:piset-transgression-exactness}%
Over $(\mathsf{ZC}_{\neg\mathrm{Reg}}, \mathsf{GBC}_{0,\neg\mathrm{Reg}})$, adjoining Global Choice $\mathsf{GC}$ induces an exact $2 \times 2$ classification across all four $(\mathrm{Replacement}, \mathrm{Foundation})$ quadrants for the horizontal transgression operator {{sym:dset}} of Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:piset-transgression-exactness}:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\arabic*)},leftmargin=2.0em]
  \item \textbf{Quadrant $(1, 1)$ ($\mathsf{ZFC}$ / {{sym:nbg}}):} Both insulation valves are closed; Felgner's $\kappa$-closed forcing membrane (Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:felgner-kappa-closed-membrane}~\cite{felgner1971}) enforces ${{sym:dset}}(\mathsf{GC}) = \bot$.
  \item \textbf{Quadrant $(0, 1)$ ($\mathsf{ZC}$ / ${{sym:gbc0}} + \mathsf{GC}$):} Dropping Replacement opens the Hartogs--Scott compression valve (Proposition~\ref{ch03:prop:glazer-hartogs-scott-surjection}~\cite{glazer2023}), placing $\neg\theta_{\mathrm{Glz}} \in {{sym:uleak}}(\mathsf{GC})$ so ${{sym:dset}}(\mathsf{GC}) \neq \bot$ (precisely scoped above Mathias's~\cite{mathias2001} $\mathsf{Mac}$/${{sym:gb0}}$ boundary of Claim~\ref{ch03:claim:mathias-gb0-nonconservative-over-mac}).
  \item \textbf{Quadrant $(1, 0)$ ({{sym:zfc-noreg}} + $\mathrm{Collection}$ / {{sym:nbg-noreg}}):} Dropping Foundation opens the ill-founded rank valve (Claim~\ref{ch03:claim:felgner76-foundation-free-dc-ord-leak}~\cite{felgner1976}), placing ${{sym:dc-ord}} \in {{sym:uleak}}(\mathsf{GC})$ so ${{sym:dset}}(\mathsf{GC}) \neq \bot$.
  \item \textbf{Quadrant $(0, 0)$ ($\mathsf{ZC}_{\neg\mathrm{Reg}}$ / $\mathsf{GBC}_{0,\neg\mathrm{Reg}} + \mathsf{GC}$):} Both independent leakage channels $\neg\theta_{\mathrm{Glz}}$ and ${{sym:dc-ord}}$ are simultaneously active in ${{sym:uleak}}(\mathsf{GC})$.
\end{enumerate}
In particular, ${{sym:dset}}(\mathsf{GC}) = \bot \iff (\mathrm{Replacement} \wedge \mathrm{Foundation})$ holds across the four-quadrant base matrix.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Combining Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:piset-transgression-exactness}(1) with the four-quadrant separation results: in Quadrant~$(1, 1)$, Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:felgner-kappa-closed-membrane} eliminates every $\mathcal{L}_\in$-leak so ${{sym:dset}}(\mathsf{ZFC}, \mathsf{GC}) = \bot_{\mathsf{ZFC}}$. In Quadrant~$(0, 1)$, Glazer's symmetric model satisfies $\mathsf{ZC} + \theta_{\mathrm{Glz}}$ while Proposition~\ref{ch03:prop:glazer-hartogs-scott-surjection} proves ${{sym:gbc0}} + \mathsf{GC} \vdash \neg\theta_{\mathrm{Glz}}$; hence $\neg\theta_{\mathrm{Glz}} \in {{sym:uleak}}(\mathsf{ZC}, \mathsf{GC})$ and ${{sym:dset}}(\mathsf{ZC}, \mathsf{GC}) \neq \bot$, whereas $\mathsf{ZFC} \vdash \neg\theta_{\mathrm{Glz}}$ absorbs the leak in Quadrant~$(1, 1)$ by Theorem~\ref{ch03:thm:piset-transgression-exactness}(3). In Quadrant~$(1, 0)$, Claim~\ref{ch03:claim:felgner76-foundation-free-dc-ord-leak} shows ${{sym:nbg-noreg}} \vdash {{sym:dc-ord}}$ while Fraenkel--Mostowski / Rieger--Bernays constructions leave {{sym:dc-ord}} unprovable in {{sym:zfc-noreg}} + $\mathrm{Collection}$, so ${{sym:dc-ord}} \in {{sym:uleak}}({{sym:zfc-noreg}}, \mathsf{GC})$ while Foundation absorbs the leak in Quadrant~$(1, 1)$. In Quadrant~$(0, 0)$, both independent generators inhabit ${{sym:uleak}}(\mathsf{ZC}_{\neg\mathrm{Reg}}, \mathsf{GC})$. Finally, \texttt{two\_valve\_transgression\_dichotomy} in \texttt{PiSetTransgression.lean} mechanizes the exact four-quadrant Lindenbaum frame \texttt{quadrantClassSystem} axiom-free, certifying $\mathrm{dSetGC}(r, f) \iff (r = \mathrm{true} \wedge f = \mathrm{true})$ and mutual independence of both leakage atoms.
\end{proof}
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Deductively closed base theory in the 4-generator Lindenbaum frame over `ZC_{¬Reg}`:
    `Rep ⊢ ¬θ_Glz` (Replacement closes Glazer's valve) and `Reg ⊢ σ_Fel` (Foundation closes
    Felgner's ill-founded `DC_Ord` valve). -/
structure QuadSetTh : Type where
  /-- Flags for `Rep`, `Reg`, Glazer's `¬θ_Glz`, and Felgner's `DC_Ord` leak, with closure laws. -/
  hasRep : Bool
  hasReg : Bool
  hasNotGlz : Bool
  hasDCOrd : Bool
  rep_imp_notGlz : hasRep = true → hasNotGlz = true
  reg_imp_dcOrd : hasReg = true → hasDCOrd = true

private def boolLe (a b : Bool) : Prop := a = true → b = true

private theorem boolLe_or_left (a b : Bool) : boolLe a (a || b) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> intro h <;> first | rfl | exact Bool.noConfusion h

private theorem boolLe_or_right (a b : Bool) : boolLe b (a || b) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> intro h <;> first | rfl | exact Bool.noConfusion h

private theorem boolOr_le {a b c : Bool} (ha : boolLe a c) (hb : boolLe b c) :
    boolLe (a || b) c := by
  cases a
  · exact hb
  · intro _; exact ha rfl

private theorem boolOr_false_le (a : Bool) : boolLe (a || false) a := by
  cases a
  · intro h; exact Bool.noConfusion h
  · intro _; rfl

/-- Deductive inclusion on `QuadSetTh`. -/
def quadSetLe (a b : QuadSetTh) : Prop :=
  boolLe a.hasRep b.hasRep ∧ boolLe a.hasReg b.hasReg ∧
  boolLe a.hasNotGlz b.hasNotGlz ∧ boolLe a.hasDCOrd b.hasDCOrd

/-- Deductive join `a ⊔ b` on `QuadSetTh`. -/
def quadSetSup (a b : QuadSetTh) : QuadSetTh where
  hasRep := a.hasRep || b.hasRep
  hasReg := a.hasReg || b.hasReg
  hasNotGlz := a.hasNotGlz || b.hasNotGlz
  hasDCOrd := a.hasDCOrd || b.hasDCOrd
  rep_imp_notGlz h := by
    cases ha : a.hasRep
    · rw [ha, Bool.false_or] at h
      exact boolLe_or_right _ _ (b.rep_imp_notGlz h)
    · exact boolLe_or_left _ _ (a.rep_imp_notGlz ha)
  reg_imp_dcOrd h := by
    cases ha : a.hasReg
    · rw [ha, Bool.false_or] at h
      exact boolLe_or_right _ _ (b.reg_imp_dcOrd h)
    · exact boolLe_or_left _ _ (a.reg_imp_dcOrd ha)

/-- Two-sorted class theory `(base, hasGC)` over `QuadSetTh`. -/
structure QuadClsTh : Type where
  /-- Base set theory component and Global Choice toggle `hasGC`. -/
  base : QuadSetTh
  hasGC : Bool

/-- First-order `L_∈`-trace `Tr_set(base, hasGC)`: adjoining `GC` proves both `¬θ_Glz` and
    `σ_Fel` (`DC_Ord`-leak). -/
def quadTraceSet (S : QuadClsTh) : QuadSetTh where
  hasRep := S.base.hasRep
  hasReg := S.base.hasReg
  hasNotGlz := S.base.hasNotGlz || S.hasGC
  hasDCOrd := S.base.hasDCOrd || S.hasGC
  rep_imp_notGlz h := boolLe_or_left _ _ (S.base.rep_imp_notGlz h)
  reg_imp_dcOrd h := boolLe_or_left _ _ (S.base.reg_imp_dcOrd h)

/-- Deductive inclusion on `QuadClsTh` aligned with `Tr_set`. -/
def quadClsLe (S₁ S₂ : QuadClsTh) : Prop :=
  boolLe S₁.hasGC S₂.hasGC ∧ quadSetLe S₁.base (quadTraceSet S₂)

/-- Concrete 4-quadrant Lindenbaum-frame `SyntacticClassSystem`. -/
def quadrantClassSystem : SyntacticClassSystem where
  SetTh :=
    { T := QuadSetTh
      le := quadSetLe
      le_refl := fun _ ↦ ⟨id, id, id, id⟩
      le_trans := fun h₁ h₂ ↦
        ⟨fun h ↦ h₂.1 (h₁.1 h), fun h ↦ h₂.2.1 (h₁.2.1 h),
         fun h ↦ h₂.2.2.1 (h₁.2.2.1 h), fun h ↦ h₂.2.2.2 (h₁.2.2.2 h)⟩
      sup := quadSetSup
      le_sup_left := fun _ _ ↦ ⟨boolLe_or_left _ _, boolLe_or_left _ _,
        boolLe_or_left _ _, boolLe_or_left _ _⟩
      le_sup_right := fun _ _ ↦ ⟨boolLe_or_right _ _, boolLe_or_right _ _,
        boolLe_or_right _ _, boolLe_or_right _ _⟩
      sup_le := fun h₁ h₂ ↦ ⟨boolOr_le h₁.1 h₂.1, boolOr_le h₁.2.1 h₂.2.1,
        boolOr_le h₁.2.2.1 h₂.2.2.1, boolOr_le h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2⟩ }
  ClsTh :=
    { T := QuadClsTh
      le := quadClsLe
      le_refl := fun _ ↦ ⟨id, id, id, boolLe_or_left _ _, boolLe_or_left _ _⟩
      le_trans := fun h₁ h₂ ↦
        ⟨fun h ↦ h₂.1 (h₁.1 h), h₂.2.1 ∘ h₁.2.1, h₂.2.2.1 ∘ h₁.2.2.1,
          fun h ↦ boolOr_le h₂.2.2.2.1 (fun hg ↦ boolLe_or_right _ _ (h₂.1 hg)) (h₁.2.2.2.1 h),
          fun h ↦ boolOr_le h₂.2.2.2.2 (fun hg ↦ boolLe_or_right _ _ (h₂.1 hg)) (h₁.2.2.2.2 h)⟩
      sup := fun a b ↦ ⟨quadSetSup a.base b.base, a.hasGC || b.hasGC⟩
      le_sup_left := fun _ _ ↦
        ⟨boolLe_or_left _ _, boolLe_or_left _ _, boolLe_or_left _ _,
          fun h ↦ boolLe_or_left _ _ (boolLe_or_left _ _ h),
          fun h ↦ boolLe_or_left _ _ (boolLe_or_left _ _ h)⟩
      le_sup_right := fun _ _ ↦
        ⟨boolLe_or_right _ _, boolLe_or_right _ _, boolLe_or_right _ _,
          fun h ↦ boolLe_or_left _ _ (boolLe_or_right _ _ h),
          fun h ↦ boolLe_or_left _ _ (boolLe_or_right _ _ h)⟩
      sup_le := fun h₁ h₂ ↦
        ⟨boolOr_le h₁.1 h₂.1, boolOr_le h₁.2.1 h₂.2.1, boolOr_le h₁.2.2.1 h₂.2.2.1,
          boolOr_le h₁.2.2.2.1 h₂.2.2.2.1, boolOr_le h₁.2.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2.2⟩ }
  defSyn := fun T ↦ ⟨T, false⟩
  traceSet := quadTraceSet
  defSyn_mono := fun h ↦
    ⟨fun hf ↦ Bool.noConfusion hf, h.1, h.2.1,
      fun x ↦ boolLe_or_left _ _ (h.2.2.1 x), fun x ↦ boolLe_or_left _ _ (h.2.2.2 x)⟩
  traceSet_mono := fun h ↦
    ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.1,
      boolOr_le h.2.2.2.1 (fun hg ↦ boolLe_or_right _ _ (h.1 hg)),
      boolOr_le h.2.2.2.2 (fun hg ↦ boolLe_or_right _ _ (h.1 hg))⟩
  defSyn_le_iff := fun _ _ ↦
    ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨fun hf ↦ Bool.noConfusion hf, h⟩⟩
  defSyn_cons := fun T ↦
    ⟨id, id, boolOr_false_le T.hasNotGlz, boolOr_false_le T.hasDCOrd⟩

/-- Base theory for each `(rep, reg)` quadrant: `(1,1)=ZFC`, `(0,1)=ZC`,
    `(1,0)=ZFC_{¬Reg}`, `(0,0)=ZC_{¬Reg}`. -/
def quadrantBase (rep reg : Bool) : QuadSetTh where
  hasRep := rep
  hasReg := reg
  hasNotGlz := rep
  hasDCOrd := reg
  rep_imp_notGlz := id
  reg_imp_dcOrd := id

/-- Pure Global Choice class axiom `τ = GC`. -/
def gcAxiom : QuadClsTh := ⟨quadrantBase false false, true⟩

/-- Glazer leakage generator `¬θ_Glz`. -/
def notGlzLeakAtom : QuadSetTh :=
  ⟨false, false, true, false, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h⟩

/-- Felgner 1976 ill-founded leakage generator `σ_Fel` (`DC_Ord`-leak). -/
def dcOrdLeakAtom : QuadSetTh :=
  ⟨false, false, false, true, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h⟩

/-- Transgression vanishing predicate `dSetGC rep reg` across the four `(Rep, Reg)` quadrants. -/
def dSetGC (rep reg : Bool) : Prop :=
  dSetEqBot quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase rep reg) gcAxiom

/-- **Two-Valve Base–Fiber Dichotomy Witness (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Across the 4-quadrant Lindenbaum frame `quadrantClassSystem`:
    (1) `dSetGC rep reg ↔ (rep = true ∧ reg = true)`;
    (2) `(0, 1)` (`ZC`) leaks `¬θ_Glz` but not `σ_Fel`;
    (3) `(1, 0)` (`ZFC_{¬Reg}`) leaks `σ_Fel` but not `¬θ_Glz`;
    (4) `(0, 0)` (`ZC_{¬Reg}`) activates both independent leakage generators. -/
theorem two_valve_transgression_dichotomy :
    (∀ rep reg : Bool, dSetGC rep reg ↔ (rep = true ∧ reg = true)) ∧
    (ULeak quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase false true) gcAxiom notGlzLeakAtom ∧
      ¬ ULeak quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase false true) gcAxiom dcOrdLeakAtom) ∧
    (ULeak quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase true false) gcAxiom dcOrdLeakAtom ∧
      ¬ ULeak quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase true false) gcAxiom notGlzLeakAtom) ∧
    (ULeak quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase false false) gcAxiom notGlzLeakAtom ∧
      ULeak quadrantClassSystem (quadrantBase false false) gcAxiom dcOrdLeakAtom ∧
      ¬ quadSetLe notGlzLeakAtom dcOrdLeakAtom ∧
      ¬ quadSetLe dcOrdLeakAtom notGlzLeakAtom) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
