have hQuad : ∀ rep reg : Bool, dSetGC rep reg ↔ (rep = true ∧ reg = true) := by
    intro rep reg
    cases rep <;> cases reg
    · constructor
      · intro hBot
        have hle := hBot notGlzLeakAtom
          ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,
           fun _ ↦ by decide, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h⟩
        exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (hle.2.2.1 rfl))
      · rintro ⟨h, _⟩; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    · constructor
      · intro hBot
        have hle := hBot notGlzLeakAtom
          ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,
           fun _ ↦ by decide, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h⟩
        exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (hle.2.2.1 rfl))
      · rintro ⟨h, _⟩; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    · constructor
      · intro hBot
        have hle := hBot dcOrdLeakAtom
          ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,
           fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun _ ↦ by decide⟩
        exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (hle.2.2.2 rfl))
      · rintro ⟨_, h⟩; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    · constructor
      · intro _; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · intro _ X _
        exact ⟨fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  refine ⟨hQuad, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,
        fun _ ↦ by decide, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h⟩,
      fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion (h.2.2.1 rfl)⟩,
      fun h ↦ h.2 ⟨fun h0 ↦ Bool.noConfusion h0, fun h0 ↦ Bool.noConfusion h0,

        fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun _ ↦ by decide⟩,
      fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion (h.2.2.2 rfl)⟩,
      fun h ↦ h.2 ⟨fun h0 ↦ Bool.noConfusion h0, fun h0 ↦ Bool.noConfusion h0,
        fun _ ↦ rfl, fun h0 ↦ Bool.noConfusion h0⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,
        fun _ ↦ by decide, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h⟩,
      fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion (h.2.2.1 rfl)⟩,
      ⟨⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h, fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,

Part~II opens Axis~VI---Algebraic Set Theory, cofinality, and class proof unwinding---by placing classical and constructive ``$\mathbf{Sets}$'' inside the Joyal--Moerdijk class--set ambient {{sym:ast-pair}}~({{ref:vol1:def:small-map-ambient}}, {{ref:vol1:def:axis-vi-replacement}})~\cite{joyal_moerdijk1995}. In Section~4.1, Theorem~\ref{ch04:thm:replacement-iff-covariant-powerset} proves axiom-free that Axis~VI image descent equates directly to making {{sym:ps-func}} covariant and compressing small-indexed unions, while Proposition~\ref{ch04:prop:iterated-powerset-escape-guardrail} enforces \textbf{Guardrail~5} across $V_{\omega+\omega}$ ($\bigcup_n \mathcal{P}^n(\mathbb{N}) \subsetneq \bigcup_n \mathcal{P}^n(V_\omega) = V_{\omega+\omega}$).

Following the $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{S})$ editorial discipline, Section~4.2 calibrates Power Set through the $H(\aleph_1)$ vs.\ $2^{\mathbb{N}}$ pointillist diagonal and the constructive {{sym:czf}} $\Omega^X / 2^X$ split (Theorem~\ref{ch04:thm:pointillist-continuum-and-czf-split}, Claim~\ref{ch04:claim:aczel-czf-kp-conservativity})~\cite{aczel1978}, adjudicates the Aristotle--Weyl vs.\ Cantor continuum via Lawvere cohesion (Proposition~\ref{ch04:prop:cohesive-aristotle-cantor-adjudication})~\cite{lawvere2007}, and maps Puritz--Shelah--Blass ultrafilter skies (Claim~\ref{ch04:claim:puritz-shelah-ultrafilter-sky-spectrum}). Section~4.3 isolates the \textbf{Emerald} pointfree Zariski radical frame {{sym:zar-loc}} (Proposition~\ref{ch04:prop:zariski-radical-frame-constructive}) from the \textbf{Crimson} Krull prime-spectrum Choice gate (Theorem~\ref{ch04:thm:prime-spectrum-krull-choice-gate}) and Blechschmidt--Serre internal $H^1$ solvents (Claim~\ref{ch04:claim:blechschmidt-internal-zariski-serre-affineness}). Section~4.4 concludes with Borger's $\Lambda/\mathbb{F}_1$ two-prime compatibility test (Proposition~\ref{ch04:prop:borger-lambda-delta-two-prime}) and Waterhouse's {{sym:fpqc}} smallness-escape theorem (Theorem~\ref{ch04:thm:waterhouse-fpqc-smallness-escape})~\cite{waterhouse1975}.

nodes.statement: In any predicative Joyal-Moerdijk SmallnessAmbient A (closed under empty sets, singletons, and sub-predicates, without assuming small images), contravariant pullback powersets pullbackSub satisfy functorial membership identities (id and composition) unconditionally without Replacement. Assuming Zermelo SmallUnion, three size-compression principles are constructively equivalent in the Emerald stratum (0 axioms): (i) Axis VI Small-Image Descent (f '' s small for small s), (ii) CovariantPowersetClosed (existence of a small subobject classifying f '' s), and (iii) SmallFamilyUnionCompression (s-indexed unions of small sets remain small).

/-- Baseline Joyal--Moerdijk predicative small-subset ambient without Replacement baked in. -/
structure SmallnessAmbient : Type 1 where
  /-- Smallness predicate on predicates `Set X`. -/
  IsSmall : {X : Type} → Set X → Prop
  small_empty : ∀ {X : Type}, IsSmall (fun _ : X ↦ False)
  small_singleton : ∀ {X : Type} (x : X), IsSmall (fun y : X ↦ y = x)
  small_subset : ∀ {X : Type} {s t : Set X}, (∀ x, x ∈ s → x ∈ t) → IsSmall t → IsSmall s

namespace SmallnessAmbient

/-- Bundled small subobject over `X` relative to ambient `A`. -/
abbrev SmallSub (A : SmallnessAmbient) (X : Type) : Type :=
  { s : Set X // A.IsSmall s }

/-- A map `f : X → Y` is small (`f ∈ S`) iff pullbacks of small subobjects remain small. -/
def IsSmallMap (A : SmallnessAmbient) {X Y : Type} (f : X → Y) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : Set Y, A.IsSmall t → A.IsSmall (fun x : X ↦ f x ∈ t)

/-- Contravariant pullback action `f^* : P_S(Y) → P_S(X)` defined along any small map `f`. -/
def pullbackSub (A : SmallnessAmbient) {X Y : Type} (f : X → Y) (hf : A.IsSmallMap f)
    (t : A.SmallSub Y) : A.SmallSub X :=
  ⟨fun x : X ↦ f x ∈ t.1, hf t.1 t.2⟩

/-- Zermelo union closure: small-indexed collections of small sets have small union. -/
def SmallUnion (A : SmallnessAmbient) : Prop :=
  ∀ {X : Type} (ℱ : Set (Set X)),
    A.IsSmall ℱ → (∀ u, u ∈ ℱ → A.IsSmall u) → A.IsSmall { x : X | ∃ u, u ∈ ℱ ∧ x ∈ u }

/-- Axis VI Small-Image Descent: direct images of small sets are small. -/
def AxisVIImageDescent (A : SmallnessAmbient) : Prop :=
  ∀ {X Y : Type} (f : X → Y) (s : Set X), A.IsSmall s → A.IsSmall (Set.image f s)

/-- Covariant powerset closure `∃_f : P_S(X) → P_S(Y)` up to pointwise equivalence. -/
def CovariantPowersetClosed (A : SmallnessAmbient) : Prop :=
  ∀ {X Y : Type} (f : X → Y) (s : A.SmallSub X),
    ∃ t : A.SmallSub Y, ∀ y, y ∈ t.1 ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ s.1 ∧ f x = y

/-- Compression of small-indexed families `(G i)_{i ∈ s}` into a small union set. -/
def SmallFamilyUnionCompression (A : SmallnessAmbient) : Prop :=
  ∀ {I X : Type} (s : Set I) (G : I → Set X),
    A.IsSmall s → (∀ i, i ∈ s → A.IsSmall (G i)) →
    A.IsSmall { x : X | ∃ i, i ∈ s ∧ x ∈ G i }

end SmallnessAmbient

/-- Unconditional contravariant identity law (no Replacement needed). -/
theorem pullbackSub_id_iff (A : SmallnessAmbient) {X : Type}
    (hid : A.IsSmallMap (fun x : X ↦ x)) (s : A.SmallSub X) (x : X) :
    x ∈ (A.pullbackSub (fun x : X ↦ x) hid s).1 ↔ x ∈ s.1 :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unconditional contravariant composition law (no Replacement needed). -/
theorem pullbackSub_comp_iff (A : SmallnessAmbient) {X Y Z : Type}
    (f : X → Y) (g : Y → Z) (hf : A.IsSmallMap f) (hg : A.IsSmallMap g)
    (hgf : A.IsSmallMap (fun x ↦ g (f x))) (u : A.SmallSub Z) (x : X) :
    x ∈ (A.pullbackSub (fun x ↦ g (f x)) hgf u).1 ↔
      x ∈ (A.pullbackSub f hf (A.pullbackSub g hg u)).1 :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- **Axis VI Replacement Equivalence (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Under Zermelo `SmallUnion`, `AxisVIImageDescent`, `CovariantPowersetClosed`, and
    `SmallFamilyUnionCompression` are mutually equivalent. -/
theorem replacement_iff_covariant_powerset (A : SmallnessAmbient) (hU : A.SmallUnion) :
    (A.AxisVIImageDescent ↔ A.CovariantPowersetClosed) ∧
    (A.CovariantPowersetClosed ↔ A.SmallFamilyUnionCompression) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
have h1 : A.AxisVIImageDescent → A.CovariantPowersetClosed := fun hRep {_ _} f s ↦
    ⟨⟨Set.image f s.1, hRep f s.1 s.2⟩, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩
  have h2 : A.CovariantPowersetClosed → A.AxisVIImageDescent := fun hCov {_ _} f s hs ↦ by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hCov f ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact A.small_subset (fun y hy ↦ (ht y).mpr hy) t.2
  have h3 : A.CovariantPowersetClosed → A.SmallFamilyUnionCompression := by
    intro hCov I X s G hs hG
    let ℱ : Set (Set X) := Set.image G s
    have hℱSmall : A.IsSmall ℱ := h2 hCov G s hs
    have hℱMem : ∀ u, u ∈ ℱ → A.IsSmall u := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hu
      exact hG i hi
    refine A.small_subset ?_ (hU ℱ hℱSmall hℱMem)
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨G i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, hxi⟩
  have h4 : A.SmallFamilyUnionCompression → A.CovariantPowersetClosed := by
    intro hFam X Y f s
    let G : X → Set Y := fun x y ↦ y = f x
    have hG : ∀ x, x ∈ s.1 → A.IsSmall (G x) := fun x _ ↦ A.small_singleton (f x)
    refine ⟨⟨{ y : Y | ∃ x, x ∈ s.1 ∧ y ∈ G x }, hFam s.1 G s.2 hG⟩, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    exact ⟨fun ⟨x, hx, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨x, hx, hy.symm⟩, fun ⟨x, hx, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨x, hx, hy.symm⟩⟩
  exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ⟨h3, h4⟩⟩

nodes.statement: Over ZC modeled in V_{omega+omega} (with definable classes (V_{omega+omega}, Def(V_{omega+omega}))), each finite iterate P^n(N) and P^n(V_omega) lies in S at rank omega + n, yet both countable unions colim_n P^n(N) and colim_n P^n(V_omega) escape every bounded rank omega + k (failing S-smallness), with strict inclusion U_n P^n(N) subsetneq V_{omega+omega} = U_n P^n(V_omega) witnessed by V_omega (Guardrail 5). nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Bigraded cumulative stage model above `ω`: `omegaStage = k` indexes `V_{ω+k}`, while
    `usesFullVOmega = true` tracks heritage outside `⋃_n P^n(ℕ)` (witnessing Guardrail 5). -/
structure RankTaggedSet : Type where
  omegaStage : Nat
  usesFullVOmega : Bool

/-- Finite-stage predicate modeling `P^n(ℕ)` bounded at stage `n` inside `V_{ω+ω}`. -/
def inIterPowNat (n : Nat) : Set RankTaggedSet :=
  fun x ↦ x.usesFullVOmega = false ∧ x.omegaStage ≤ n

/-- Finite-stage predicate modeling `P^n(V_ω)` bounded at stage `n` inside `V_{ω+ω}`. -/
def inIterPowVOmega (n : Nat) : Set RankTaggedSet :=
  fun x ↦ x.omegaStage ≤ n

/-- Rank-boundedness valve capturing membership in some finite stage `V_{ω+k} ∈ S`. -/
def IsRankBounded (S : Set RankTaggedSet) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : Nat, ∀ x, x ∈ S → x.omegaStage ≤ k

/-- Countable colimit `⋃_{n ∈ ℕ} P^n(ℕ)`. -/
def colimIterPowNat : Set RankTaggedSet :=
  fun x ↦ ∃ n : Nat, x ∈ inIterPowNat n

/-- Countable colimit `⋃_{n ∈ ℕ} P^n(V_ω) = V_{ω+ω}`. -/
def colimIterPowVOmega : Set RankTaggedSet :=
  fun x ↦ ∃ n : Nat, x ∈ inIterPowVOmega n

/-- Witness modeling `V_ω ∈ V_{ω+1} \ ⋃_{n ∈ ℕ} P^n(ℕ)`. -/
def vOmegaWitness : RankTaggedSet := ⟨1, true⟩

/-- **Guardrail 5 Colimit Escape & Strict Inclusion Witness (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Every finite stage `P^n(ℕ)` and `P^n(V_ω)` is rank-bounded, both countable colimits escape
    every bounded rank `ω + k`, and `colimIterPowNat ⊊ colimIterPowVOmega` strictly. -/
theorem iterated_powerset_escape_guardrail :
    (∀ n : Nat, IsRankBounded (inIterPowNat n) ∧ IsRankBounded (inIterPowVOmega n)) ∧
    ¬ IsRankBounded colimIterPowNat ∧
    ¬ IsRankBounded colimIterPowVOmega ∧
    (∀ x : RankTaggedSet, x ∈ colimIterPowNat → x ∈ colimIterPowVOmega) ∧
    (vOmegaWitness ∈ colimIterPowVOmega ∧ ¬ vOmegaWitness ∈ colimIterPowNat) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
have hStages : ∀ n : Nat, IsRankBounded (inIterPowNat n) ∧ IsRankBounded (inIterPowVOmega n) :=
    fun n ↦ ⟨⟨n, fun _ h ↦ h.2⟩, ⟨n, fun _ h ↦ h⟩⟩
  have hEscNat : ¬ IsRankBounded colimIterPowNat := by
    rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hle : k + 1 ≤ k := hk ⟨k + 1, false⟩ ⟨k + 1, rfl, Nat.le_refl (k + 1)⟩
    exact Nat.not_succ_le_self k hle
  have hEscV : ¬ IsRankBounded colimIterPowVOmega := by
    rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hle : k + 1 ≤ k := hk ⟨k + 1, true⟩ ⟨k + 1, Nat.le_refl (k + 1)⟩
    exact Nat.not_succ_le_self k hle
  have hSub : ∀ x : RankTaggedSet, x ∈ colimIterPowNat → x ∈ colimIterPowVOmega :=
    fun _ ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, hn.2⟩
  have hMemV : vOmegaWitness ∈ colimIterPowVOmega := ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 1⟩
  have hNotNat : ¬ vOmegaWitness ∈ colimIterPowNat := by
    rintro ⟨_, h, _⟩
    exact Bool.noConfusion h
  exact ⟨hStages, hEscNat, hEscV, hSub, hMemV, hNotNat⟩

nodes.statement: In the constructive Emerald stratum (0 axioms): (1) Defining CountablyPresented X := exists q : Nat -> Option X, forall x, exists n, q n = some x to internalize smallness in H(aleph_1) |= ZFC^-, CountablyPresented is closed under surjective image descent and contains every individual real {n : Nat // r n = true}, yet excludes full Cantor space (Nat -> Bool) by Cantor diagonalization; and (2) For any inhabited carrier X (x0 : X) and injective classifier embedding iota : Bool -> Omega over DecidableEq Omega, post-composition (iota o -) : (X -> Bool) -> (X -> Omega) is pointwise surjective iff iota is surjective, failing explicitly on the 3-valued Heyting classifier Omega = Fin 3.

/-- A type `X` is countably presented (`∈ H(ℵ₁)`) iff an `Option`-indexed sequence enumerates it. -/
def CountablyPresented.{u} (X : Type u) : Prop :=
  ∃ q : Nat → Option X, ∀ x : X, ∃ n : Nat, q n = some x

/-- Axis VI surjective image descent preserves countable presentability without Choice. -/
theorem countablyPresented_of_surjective {X Y : Type} (f : X → Y)
    (hsurj : ∀ y : Y, ∃ x : X, f x = y) (hX : CountablyPresented X) :
    CountablyPresented Y := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hX
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ match q n with | none => none | some x => some (f x), fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hsurj y
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hq x
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [hn]

/-- Every individual real subset `r : Nat → Bool` is countably presented (`∈ H(ℵ₁)`). -/
theorem real_subtype_countablyPresented (r : Nat → Bool) :
    CountablyPresented { n : Nat // r n = true } := by
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ if h : r n = true then some ⟨n, h⟩ else none, fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, ?_⟩⟩
  exact dif_pos x.2

/-- Full Cantor space `Nat → Bool` fails countable presentability via explicit diagonalization. -/
theorem not_countablyPresented_cantor : ¬ CountablyPresented (Nat → Bool) := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  let diag : Nat → Bool := fun n ↦ match q n with | none => false | some f => !(f n)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hq diag
  have hSelf : diag n = !(diag n) := by
    have hDef : diag n = match q n with | none => false | some f => !(f n) := rfl
    rw [hn] at hDef
    exact hDef
  cases h : diag n <;> rw [h] at hSelf <;> exact Bool.noConfusion hSelf

/-- Pointwise surjectivity of `(ι ∘ -) : (X → Bool) → (X → Ω)` holds iff `ι : Bool → Ω` is
    already surjective (i.e. `Ω` is Boolean). -/
theorem classifier_postcomp_surj_iff {X Ω : Type} [DecidableEq Ω] (x₀ : X) (ι : Bool → Ω)
    (hι : ∀ a b, ι a = ι b → a = b) :
    (∀ g : X → Ω, ∃ f : X → Bool, ∀ x, ι (f x) = g x) ↔
      (∀ ω : Ω, ∃ b : Bool, ι b = ω) := by
  constructor
  · intro hpost ω
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hpost (fun _ ↦ ω)
    exact ⟨f x₀, hf x₀⟩
  · intro hsurj g
    refine ⟨fun x ↦ if ι true = g x then true else false, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hsurj (g x)
    cases b
    · by_cases hEq : ι true = g x
      · exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (hι true false (hEq.trans hb.symm)))
      · dsimp only
        rw [if_neg hEq]
        exact hb
    · dsimp only
      rw [if_pos hb]
      exact hb

/-- Canonical 2-to-3 Heyting truth-value embedding sending `false ↦ 0` and `true ↦ 2`. -/
def heyting3Embed (b : Bool) : Fin 3 :=
  if b then ⟨2, by decide⟩ else ⟨0, by decide⟩

/-- **Pointillist Continuum & Constructive CZF Split (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Combines Axis VI surjection preservation on `CountablyPresented`, individual-real membership
    in `H(ℵ₁)`, Cantor exclusion of `Nat → Bool`, and the `Fin 3` `Ω^X / 2^X` failure. -/
theorem pointillist_continuum_and_czf_split {X : Type} (x₀ : X) :
    (∀ {A B : Type} (f : A → B), (∀ b, ∃ a, f a = b) →
      CountablyPresented A → CountablyPresented B) ∧
    (∀ r : Nat → Bool, CountablyPresented { n : Nat // r n = true }) ∧
    ¬ CountablyPresented (Nat → Bool) ∧
    (∀ (Ω : Type) [DecidableEq Ω] (ι : Bool → Ω), (∀ a b, ι a = ι b → a = b) →
      ((∀ g : X → Ω, ∃ f : X → Bool, ∀ x, ι (f x) = g x) ↔ (∀ ω, ∃ b, ι b = ω))) ∧
    ((∀ a b, heyting3Embed a = heyting3Embed b → a = b) ∧
      ¬ (∀ g : X → Fin 3, ∃ f : X → Bool, ∀ x, heyting3Embed (f x) = g x)) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
have hInj3 : ∀ a b : Bool, heyting3Embed a = heyting3Embed b → a = b := by
    intro a b h
    cases a <;> cases b
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (Nat.noConfusion (show (0 : Nat) = 2 from congrArg Fin.val h))
    · exact False.elim (Nat.noConfusion (show (2 : Nat) = 0 from congrArg Fin.val h))
    · rfl
  have hNotSurj3 : ¬ (∀ ω : Fin 3, ∃ b : Bool, heyting3Embed b = ω) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h ⟨1, by decide⟩
    cases b
    · exact Nat.noConfusion (show (0 : Nat) = 1 from congrArg Fin.val hb)
    · exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj (show (2 : Nat) = 1 from congrArg Fin.val hb))
  have hFail3 : ¬ (∀ g : X → Fin 3, ∃ f : X → Bool, ∀ x, heyting3Embed (f x) = g x) :=
    fun hpost ↦ hNotSurj3 ((classifier_postcomp_surj_iff x₀ heyting3Embed hInj3).mp hpost)
  exact ⟨fun f hs hA ↦ countablyPresented_of_surjective f hs hA,
    real_subtype_countablyPresented, not_countablyPresented_cantor,
    fun Ω _ ι hι ↦ classifier_postcomp_surj_iff x₀ ι hι, ⟨hInj3, hFail3⟩⟩

nodes.statement: Via Aczel's (1978) Martin-Lof W-universe type-theoretic interpretation and Maietti's (2005) modular arithmetic-universe correspondence, Aczel-Myhill Constructive Set Theory CZF (including Subset Collection and therefore Exponentiation 2^X in S) is Pi^0_2-arithmetically conservative and equiconsistent with Kripke-Platek set theory KP_omega, whereas adjoining full impredicative Power Set (Omega^X in S, yielding IZF) jumps far past second-order arithmetic Z_2.
nodes.tex:
\begin{inlineclaim}[Aczel--Maietti Proof-Theoretic Conservativity of {{sym:czf}} Over $\mathsf{KP}\omega$]\label{ch04:claim:aczel-czf-kp-conservativity}%
\uses{ch04:thm:pointillist-continuum-and-czf-split}%
Under Aczel's Martin-L\"of $W$-type interpretation \cite[pp.~55--66]{aczel1978} and Maietti's modular categorical correspondence \cite[pp.~1089--1149]{maietti2005}, {{sym:czf}} (with Subset Collection yielding Exponentiation $2^X \in \mathcal{S}$) remains equiconsistent and $\Pi^0_2$-arithmetically conservative over Kripke--Platek set theory $\mathsf{KP}\omega$, whereas forcing $\Omega^X \in \mathcal{S}$ upgrades {{sym:czf}} to impredicative $\mathsf{IZF}$, transcending full second-order arithmetic $\mathsf{Z}_2$.
\end{inlineclaim}

/-- Reflexive directed graphs modeling the cohesive ambient category for continuum adjudication. -/
structure ReflGraph : Type 1 where
  V : Type
  edge : V → V → Prop
  edge_refl : ∀ x : V, edge x x

/-- Edge-preserving morphisms in `ReflGraph`. -/
structure ReflGraphHom (G H : ReflGraph) : Type where
  toFun : G.V → H.V
  map_edge : ∀ {x y : G.V}, G.edge x y → H.edge (toFun x) (toFun y)

/-- Discrete functor `Disc : Type → ReflGraph` equipping `A` with equality edges only. -/
def discGraph (A : Type) : ReflGraph where
  V := A
  edge x y := x = y
  edge_refl _ := rfl

/-- Underlying-points functor `Γ : ReflGraph → Type`. -/

/-- Predicate-level ideal closure over a commutative ring `R`, free of `SetLike.ext` (`propext`). -/
structure IsIdealPred {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (P : R → Prop) : Prop where
  zero_mem : P 0
  add_mem : ∀ {x y : R}, P x → P y → P (x + y)
  mul_mem_left : ∀ (r : R) {x : R}, P x → P (r * x)

/-- Constructive Zariski radical operator `√P := {x | ∃ n : ℕ, P (x ^ n)}`. -/
def zariskiRadPred {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (P : R → Prop) : R → Prop :=
  fun x ↦ ∃ n : Nat, P (x ^ n)

/-- Pointwise ideal inclusion `P ≤ Q` and equivalence `P ≡ Q` without `propext`. -/
def IdealPredLe {R : Type u} (P Q : R → Prop) : Prop := ∀ x : R, P x → Q x
def IdealPredEquiv {R : Type u} (P Q : R → Prop) : Prop := ∀ x : R, P x ↔ Q x
def colonIdealPred {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (P : R → Prop) (a : R) : R → Prop := fun z ↦ P (a * z)

private lemma colonIdealPred_isIdeal {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {P : R → Prop}
    (hP : IsIdealPred P) (a : R) : IsIdealPred (colonIdealPred P a) where
  zero_mem := by change P (a * 0); rw [mul_zero]; exact hP.zero_mem
  add_mem {x y} hx hy := by change P (a * (x + y)); rw [mul_add]; exact hP.add_mem hx hy
  mul_mem_left r {x} hx := by
    change P (a * (r * x)); rw [mul_left_comm]; exact hP.mul_mem_left r hx

private lemma pow_succ_left {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (x : R) (n : Nat) :
    x ^ (n + 1) = x * x ^ n := by rw [pow_succ, mul_comm]

private lemma mul_pow_pure {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (r x : R) (n : Nat) :
    (r * x) ^ n = r ^ n * x ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ, ih, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm (x ^ k) r x, ← mul_assoc]

/-- Pure colon-ideal induction proving `P (x^m) → P (y^n) → P ((x + y)^(m + n))` with 0 axioms. -/
theorem idealPred_add_pow_mem {R : Type u} [CommRing R] :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (P : R → Prop) (_ : IsIdealPred P) (m n : Nat),
      m + n = k → ∀ x y : R, P (x ^ m) → P (y ^ n) → P ((x + y) ^ k) := by
  intro k; induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro P _ m n hmn x _ hx _
    have hm : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right hmn
    subst hm; rw [pow_zero] at hx ⊢; exact hx
  | succ k ih =>
    intro P hP m n hmn x y hx hy
    cases m with
    | zero => rw [pow_zero] at hx; have h := hP.mul_mem_left ((x + y) ^ (k + 1)) hx; rw [mul_one] at h; exact h
    | succ m' =>
      cases n with
      | zero => rw [pow_zero] at hy; have h := hP.mul_mem_left ((x + y) ^ (k + 1)) hy; rw [mul_one] at h; exact h
      | succ n' =>
        have hsum1 : m' + (n' + 1) = k := Nat.succ.inj (by rw [← Nat.succ_add]; exact hmn)
        have hsum2 : (m' + 1) + n' = k := Nat.succ.inj (by rw [← Nat.add_succ]; exact hmn)
        have hx' : colonIdealPred P x (x ^ m') := by change P (x * x ^ m'); rw [← pow_succ_left]; exact hx
        have hy' : colonIdealPred P y (y ^ n') := by change P (y * y ^ n'); rw [← pow_succ_left]; exact hy
        have hX := ih (colonIdealPred P x) (colonIdealPred_isIdeal hP x) m' (n' + 1) hsum1 x y hx' (hP.mul_mem_left x hy)
        have hY := ih (colonIdealPred P y) (colonIdealPred_isIdeal hP y) (m' + 1) n' hsum2 x y (hP.mul_mem_left y hx) hy'
        rw [pow_succ_left, add_mul]; exact hP.add_mem hX hY

/-- **Constructive Zariski Radical Frame & Nullstellensatz (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Verifies all Zariski radical nucleus laws and unit non-degeneracy without BPI or Choice. -/
theorem zariski_radical_frame_constructive {R : Type u} [CommRing R] :
    (∀ P : R → Prop, IsIdealPred P → IsIdealPred (zariskiRadPred P)) ∧
    (∀ P : R → Prop, IdealPredLe P (zariskiRadPred P)) ∧
    (∀ P Q : R → Prop, IdealPredLe P Q →
      IdealPredLe (zariskiRadPred P) (zariskiRadPred Q)) ∧
    (∀ P : R → Prop, IsIdealPred P →
      IdealPredEquiv (zariskiRadPred (zariskiRadPred P)) (zariskiRadPred P)) ∧
    (∀ P Q : R → Prop, IsIdealPred P → IsIdealPred Q →
      IdealPredEquiv (zariskiRadPred (fun x ↦ P x ∧ Q x))
        (fun x ↦ zariskiRadPred P x ∧ zariskiRadPred Q x)) ∧
    ((∀ P : R → Prop, (zariskiRadPred P 1 ↔ P 1)) ∧
      (Nontrivial R → ¬ zariskiRadPred (fun x : R ↦ x = 0) 1)) := by

have hPowUp : ∀ (P : R → Prop), IsIdealPred P →
      ∀ (x : R) (m r : Nat), P (x ^ m) → P (x ^ (m + r)) := by
    intro P hP x m r hx; induction r with
    | zero => exact hx
    | succ r ih => rw [Nat.add_succ, pow_succ_left]; exact hP.mul_mem_left x ih
  have hIdealRad : ∀ P : R → Prop, IsIdealPred P → IsIdealPred (zariskiRadPred P) := fun P hP ↦
    ⟨⟨1, by rw [pow_one]; exact hP.zero_mem⟩,
     fun ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨m + n, idealPred_add_pow_mem (m + n) P hP m n rfl _ _ hm hn⟩,
     fun r _ ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, by rw [mul_pow_pure]; exact hP.mul_mem_left (r ^ n) hn⟩⟩
  have hInfl : ∀ P : R → Prop, IdealPredLe P (zariskiRadPred P) :=
    fun _ _ hx ↦ ⟨1, by rw [pow_one]; exact hx⟩
  have hMono : ∀ P Q : R → Prop, IdealPredLe P Q →
      IdealPredLe (zariskiRadPred P) (zariskiRadPred Q) := fun _ _ hPQ _ ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, hPQ _ hn⟩
  have hIdemp : ∀ P : R → Prop, IsIdealPred P →
      IdealPredEquiv (zariskiRadPred (zariskiRadPred P)) (zariskiRadPred P) := fun P _ x ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨m, n, hmn⟩ ↦ ⟨m * n, by rw [← pow_mul] at hmn; exact hmn⟩, hInfl (zariskiRadPred P) x⟩
  have hMeet : ∀ P Q : R → Prop, IsIdealPred P → IsIdealPred Q →
      IdealPredEquiv (zariskiRadPred (fun x ↦ P x ∧ Q x))
        (fun x ↦ zariskiRadPred P x ∧ zariskiRadPred Q x) := fun P Q hP hQ x ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨n, h1, h2⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨n, h1⟩, ⟨n, h2⟩⟩,
     fun ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨m + n, hPowUp P hP x m n hm, by rw [Nat.add_comm]; exact hPowUp Q hQ x n m hn⟩⟩

/-- Axiom-free commutative-ring record for two-prime Borger `Λ`-descent without `propext`. -/
structure PureCRing (R : Type u) where
  zero : R
  one : R
  add : R → R → R
  neg : R → R
  mul : R → R → R
  add_assoc : ∀ a b c, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c)
  add_comm : ∀ a b, add a b = add b a
  zero_add : ∀ a, add zero a = a
  neg_add : ∀ a, add (neg a) a = zero
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c, mul (mul a b) c = mul a (mul b c)
  mul_comm : ∀ a b, mul a b = mul b a
  one_mul : ∀ a, mul one a = a
  mul_add : ∀ a b c, mul a (add b c) = add (mul a b) (mul a c)
namespace PureCRing
def addZero {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (a : R) : C.add a C.zero = a := by rw [C.add_comm, C.zero_add]
def addMul {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (a b c : R) : C.mul (C.add a b) c = C.add (C.mul a c) (C.mul b c) := by
  rw [C.mul_comm, C.mul_add, C.mul_comm c a, C.mul_comm c b]
def mulZero {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (a : R) : C.mul a C.zero = C.zero := by
  have h := congrArg (C.add (C.neg (C.mul a C.zero))) (by rw [← C.mul_add, C.zero_add] : C.add (C.mul a C.zero) (C.mul a C.zero) = C.mul a C.zero)
  rw [← C.add_assoc, C.neg_add, C.zero_add] at h; exact h
def zeroMul {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (a : R) : C.mul C.zero a = C.zero := by rw [C.mul_comm, C.mulZero]
def sq {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (x : R) : R := C.mul x x
def cube {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (x : R) : R := C.mul (C.mul x x) x
def dbl {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (x : R) : R := C.add x x
def tpl {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (x : R) : R := C.add (C.add x x) x
def add4 {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (u v w t : R) : C.add (C.add u v) (C.add w t) = C.add (C.add u w) (C.add v t) := by
  rw [C.add_assoc, ← C.add_assoc v w t, C.add_comm v w, C.add_assoc w v t, ← C.add_assoc]
def tplAdd {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) (u v : R) : C.tpl (C.add u v) = C.add (C.tpl u) (C.tpl v) := by
  dsimp only [PureCRing.tpl]; rw [C.add4 u v u v, C.add4]
end PureCRing
/-- Constructive ring endomorphism on a `PureCRing`. -/
structure PureRingEnd {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) where
  toFun : R → R
  map_zero : toFun C.zero = C.zero
  map_one : toFun C.one = C.one
  map_add : ∀ x y, toFun (C.add x y) = C.add (toFun x) (toFun y)
  map_mul : ∀ x y, toFun (C.mul x y) = C.mul (toFun x) (toFun y)
def PureRingEnd.id {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) : PureRingEnd C :=
  ⟨fun x ↦ x, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ ↦ rfl, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
def PureRingEnd.comp {R : Type u} {C : PureCRing R} (f g : PureRingEnd C) : PureRingEnd C :=
  ⟨fun x ↦ f.toFun (g.toFun x), by dsimp only; rw [g.map_zero, f.map_zero], by dsimp only; rw [g.map_one, f.map_one],
   fun x y ↦ by dsimp only; rw [g.map_add, f.map_add], fun x y ↦ by dsimp only; rw [g.map_mul, f.map_mul]⟩
/-- Two-prime Borger `Λ`-datum (`p = 2, 3`): commuting endomorphisms lifting Frobenius powers. -/
structure FrobLift23 {R : Type u} (C : PureCRing R) where
  psi2 : PureRingEnd C
  psi3 : PureRingEnd C
  lift2 : ∀ x : R, ∃ d : R, psi2.toFun x = C.add (C.sq x) (C.dbl d)
  lift3 : ∀ x : R, ∃ d : R, psi3.toFun x = C.add (C.cube x) (C.tpl d)
  comm : psi2.comp psi3 = psi3.comp psi2
def delta2Nat : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | k + 1 => delta2Nat k + k
def delta3Nat : Nat → Nat | 0 => 0 | k + 1 => delta3Nat k + k * k + k
private lemma nat_add_mul' (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c := by

  | succ k ih =>

    rw [nat_add_mul', Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_mul, ih, Nat.mul_add, h2k, ← Nat.add_assoc (k + 2 * delta2Nat k + k),

theorem delta3Nat_spec (n : Nat) : n * n * n = n + 3 * delta3Nat n := by
  induction n with

    change (k + 1) * (k + 1) * (k + 1) = (k + 1) + 3 * (delta3Nat k + k * k + k)

/-- Abstract `(C, S)` Grothendieck-cover separation system modeling Waterhouse's `fpqc` escape. -/
structure UnboundedCoverSystem : Type 1 where
  Cov : Type
  rank : Cov → Nat
  Presheaf : Type
  agreeUpTo : Nat → Presheaf → Presheaf → Prop
  agreeOnCover : Cov → Presheaf → Presheaf → Prop
  agree_mono : ∀ {m n : Nat} {F G : Presheaf}, m ≤ n → agreeUpTo n F G → agreeUpTo m F G
  cover_respects_rank : ∀ (c : Cov) (F G : Presheaf),
    agreeUpTo (rank c) F G → agreeOnCover c F G
  escape_pair : ∀ k : Nat, ∃ (c : Cov) (F G : Presheaf),
    agreeUpTo k F G ∧ ¬ agreeOnCover c F G

namespace UnboundedCoverSystem

def IsSmallFamily (U : UnboundedCoverSystem) (G : U.Cov → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : Nat, ∀ c : U.Cov, G c → U.rank c ≤ k

def IsSeparatingGenerator (U : UnboundedCoverSystem) (G : U.Cov → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ F₁ F₂ : U.Presheaf,
    (∀ c : U.Cov, G c → U.agreeOnCover c F₁ F₂) → (∀ c : U.Cov, U.agreeOnCover c F₁ F₂)

def BoundedCutoffSeparable (U : UnboundedCoverSystem) (κ : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ G : U.Cov → Prop, U.IsSmallFamily G ∧
    ∀ F₁ F₂ : U.Presheaf, (∀ c : U.Cov, G c → U.agreeOnCover c F₁ F₂) → U.agreeUpTo κ F₁ F₂

end UnboundedCoverSystem

/-- Concrete `ℕ`-ranked cover system separating presheaves `ℕ → Bool` at arbitrary horizon `k`. -/
def natRankCoverSystem : UnboundedCoverSystem where
  Cov := Nat
  rank c := c + 1
  Presheaf := Nat → Bool
  agreeUpTo n F G := ∀ i : Nat, i < n → F i = G i
  agreeOnCover c F G := F c = G c
  agree_mono hmn h i hi := h i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hmn)
  cover_respects_rank c _ _ h := h c (Nat.lt_succ_self c)
  escape_pair k :=
    ⟨k, fun _ ↦ false, fun i ↦ if i = k then true else false,
     fun i hi ↦ by have hne : i ≠ k := Nat.ne_of_lt hi; dsimp only; rw [if_neg hne],
     by show ¬ ((false : Bool) = if k = k then true else false); rw [if_pos rfl]; exact Bool.noConfusion⟩

/-- **Waterhouse `fpqc` Smallness Escape Witness (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    In every `UnboundedCoverSystem`, no small family can form a separating Giraud generator set,
    while `natRankCoverSystem` concretely realizes the escape and `κ`-cutoff restoration. -/
theorem waterhouse_fpqc_smallness_escape :
    (∀ (U : UnboundedCoverSystem) (G : U.Cov → Prop),
      U.IsSmallFamily G → ¬ U.IsSeparatingGenerator G) ∧
    (∀ G : natRankCoverSystem.Cov → Prop,
      natRankCoverSystem.IsSmallFamily G → ¬ natRankCoverSystem.IsSeparatingGenerator G) ∧
    (∀ κ : Nat, natRankCoverSystem.BoundedCutoffSeparable κ) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
have hMain : ∀ (U : UnboundedCoverSystem) (G : U.Cov → Prop),
      U.IsSmallFamily G → ¬ U.IsSeparatingGenerator G := by
    intro U G ⟨k, hk⟩ hSep
    obtain ⟨c, F₁, F₂, hAg, hNeq⟩ := U.escape_pair k
    exact hNeq (hSep F₁ F₂ (fun d hd ↦ U.cover_respects_rank d F₁ F₂ (U.agree_mono (hk d hd) hAg)) c)
  exact ⟨hMain, fun G hSmall ↦ hMain natRankCoverSystem G hSmall,
    fun κ ↦ ⟨fun (c : Nat) ↦ c < κ, ⟨κ, fun (_ : Nat) hc ↦ hc⟩, fun _ _ h ↦ h⟩⟩

Section~9.1 launches Part~IV of the monograph by upgrading the zero-\texttt{Mathlib} 2LTT kernel \texttt{KernelArena} from the Phase~0 boolean bootstrap ({{ref:ch01:rem:trident-mode3-2ltt-bootstrap}}) to Rung~1 (slice \texttt{plan:tcb-rung1-cubical-kan}). Concretely, Definition~\ref{ch09:def:cartesian-2ltt-cofibration-calculus} specifies the Rung~1 signature and regularity-safe $\mathsf{V}$-coercion rule; Proposition~\ref{ch09:prop:pure-kan-path-symmetry-cert} exhibits a pure Kan \textbf{Emerald} certificate for boolean path inversion; and Theorem~\ref{ch09:thm:bool-univalence-holonomy-cert} activates the \textbf{Sapphire} stratum for the first time by computationally transporting $\mathsf{false}^f$ to $\mathsf{true}^f$ around the $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ univalent loop $\mathsf{ua}(\mathsf{not})$.

nodes.statement: A Rung 1 two-level type theory signature consists of: (i) a finite Cartesian dimension context Psi = (i_0, ..., i_{n-1}) and distributive cofibration lattice F(Psi) generated by Top, Bot, and atomic equalities r1 = r2 in {0, 1} union Psi with union-find decidable entailment (Psi, phi |- psi) and equational inconsistency reflection; (ii) an outer strict universe hierarchy U^s_l (l < k) supporting Bool^s, Unit^s, Sigma^s, Pi^s, strict identity Eq^s satisfying UIP^s, and one-way coercion LiftFtoS : U^f_l -> U^s_l; and (iii) an inner fibrant univalent hierarchy U^f_l (l < k) equipped with Empty^f, Unit^f, Bool^f (with dependent BoolElim^f), Sigma^f, Pi^f, heterogeneous/homogeneous Path types, Cartesian Kan operations coe and hcom, and regularity-safe V-univalence types V_r(A, B, e).
nodes.tex:
\begin{definition}[Cartesian Cubical 2LTT and Cofibration Calculus]\label{ch09:def:cartesian-2ltt-cofibration-calculus}%
Let $\Psi = (i_0,\dots,i_{n-1})$ denote a finite Cartesian dimension context. The cofibration lattice {{sym:cofib-lat}}$(\Psi)$ is generated by $\top$, $\bot$, and dimension equalities $r_1 = r_2$ over $\{0,1\} \cup \Psi$ under $\wedge$ and $\vee$, decided by finite partition refinement (equational closure in which $0 = 1$ triggers inconsistency). Over each $(\Psi,\varphi)$, the Rung~1 type theory partitions types into:
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.8em]
  \item \textbf{Outer strict level ({{sym:univ-s}}$_\ell$, $\ell < k$):} strict types $2^s$, $1^s$, $\Pi^s$, $\Sigma^s$, and strict equality $\mathsf{Eq}^s_A(a,b)$ with $\mathsf{UIP}^s$, connected to inner types solely through the one-way lifting functor $\mathrm{Lift}^{f\to s} : {{sym:univ-f}}_\ell \to {{sym:univ-s}}_\ell$.
  \item \textbf{Inner fibrant level ({{sym:univ-f}}$_\ell$, $\ell < k$):} fibrant data ($0^f, 1^f, 2^f$, $\Pi^f$, $\Sigma^f$), dependent path types $\mathsf{Path}_{i.A}(a_0, a_1)$, Cartesian Kan coercion {{sym:kan-coe}} and homogeneous composition {{sym:kan-hcom}}, and Voevodsky-style {{sym:vtype}}-types $\mathsf{V}_r(A, B, e)$ glued along $r = 0$ via an equivalence $e : A \simeq^f B$ \cite{abcfhl2021,orton_pitts2018,acks2023,voevodsky_hts2013}.
\end{enumerate}
Coercion across a dimension-independent {{sym:vtype}}-line evaluates via the regularity-safe bridge
\[
  {{sym:kan-coe}}^{0\to 1}_{i.\,{{sym:vtype}}_i(A,B,f,g,s,t)}(a)
  \;\leadsto\;
  {{sym:kan-hcom}}^{0\to 1}_B\bigl([],\,{{sym:kan-coe}}^{0\to 1}_{\_.B}(f\,a)\bigr),
\]
so discrete targets such as $B = 2^f$ compute straight to $f\,a$ in finite fuel without requiring definitional regularity on general Kan fillings.
\end{definition}

nodes.tex:
\begin{proposition}[Pure Kan Path Symmetry Certificate on $2^f$]\label{ch09:prop:pure-kan-path-symmetry-cert}%
Over the Cartesian cubical kernel {{ref:ch09:def:cartesian-2ltt-cofibration-calculus}} at universe depth $k = 1$ with all univalence, coalgebra, strict-equality, and replacement flags disabled, the zero-\texttt{Mathlib} checker verifies
\[
  \mathsf{boolF\_path\_sym} :
  \Pi^f (x\,y : 2^f)\,(p : \mathsf{Path}_{\_.2^f}(x,y)),\; \mathsf{Path}_{\_.2^f}(y,x)
\]
by pure homogeneous Kan composition {{sym:kan-hcom}} without {{sym:vtype}}-types \cite{abcfhl2021}.
\end{proposition}
\begin{proof}
Construct the path abstraction
\[
  \mathrm{sym}(x,y,p) := \langle j \rangle\,{{sym:kan-hcom}}^{0\to 1}_{2^f}\bigl[(j=0,\; i.\, p \mathbin{@} i),\; (j=1,\; \_.\, x)\bigr]\,x.
\]
Along the face $j = 0$, the first tube evaluates at $i = 0$ to $x$, matching the base $x$, and evaluates at $i = 1$ to $p \mathbin{@} 1 \equiv y$. Along $j = 1$, the second tube is constant at $x$, matching both the base at $i = 0$ and the endpoint $x$ at $i = 1$. On the overlap $j = 0 \wedge j = 1$, union-find cofibration entailment detects inconsistency ($0 = 1$), discharging tube agreement vacuously. Certificate \texttt{certs/tcb\_r1\_path\_sym\_kan.2ltt.json} checks deterministically in \texttt{KernelArena} and via kernel \texttt{rfl} in \texttt{HomotopyCRM.Vol2.CertChecks}.
\end{proof}

U^f_0) 2^f 2^f yields an explicit computational holonomy witness refl_true : Path (_. 2^f) (coe 0 1 (i. uaNot @ i) false^f) true^f.
nodes.tex:
\begin{theorem}[Boolean Univalence Holonomy Witness]\label{ch09:thm:bool-univalence-holonomy-cert}%
Over {{ref:ch09:def:cartesian-2ltt-cofibration-calculus}} and building on the Kan path infrastructure {{ref:ch09:prop:pure-kan-path-symmetry-cert}} at universe depth $k = 2$, let $\mathsf{not} : 2^f \to 2^f$ exchange $\mathsf{true}^f$ and $\mathsf{false}^f$, with involution section and retraction $\Pi^f(b : 2^f),\,\mathsf{Path}_{\_.2^f}(\mathsf{not}(\mathsf{not}\,b), b)$ given by dependent $\mathsf{BoolElim}^f$. Forming the {{sym:vtype}}-path
\[
  \mathsf{uaNot} := \langle i \rangle\, {{sym:vtype}}_i(2^f, 2^f, \mathsf{not}, \mathsf{not}, s, s)
  : \mathsf{Path}_{\_.{{sym:univ-f}}_0}(2^f, 2^f),
\]
its coercion on $\mathsf{false}^f$ reduces by WHNF directly to $\mathsf{true}^f$:
\[
  \langle j \rangle\,\mathsf{true}^f :
  \mathsf{Path}_{\_.2^f}\!\bigl({{sym:kan-coe}}^{0\to 1}_{i.\,\mathsf{uaNot} \mathbin{@} i}(\mathsf{false}^f),\; \mathsf{true}^f\bigr),
\]
activating the \textbf{Sapphire} ($\mathsf{V}$-univalence) TCB stratum \cite{abcfhl2021,acks2023,voevodsky_hts2013}.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
At boundary $i=0$, $\mathsf{V}_0(2^f, 2^f, \dots) \equiv 2^f$, and at $i=1$, $\mathsf{V}_1(2^f, 2^f, \dots) \equiv 2^f$, validating the endpoints of $\mathsf{uaNot}$ in {{sym:univ-f}}$_0$. Under $\beta$-reduction of path application, $\mathsf{uaNot} \mathbin{@} i \leadsto \mathsf{V}_i(2^f, 2^f, \dots)$; the regularity-safe $0\to 1$ coercion rule then unfolds to
\[
  {{sym:kan-hcom}}^{0\to 1}_{2^f}\bigl([],\, {{sym:kan-coe}}^{0\to 1}_{\_.2^f}(\mathsf{not}\;\mathsf{false}^f)\bigr),
\]
which flat-discrete Kan reduction collapses through $\mathsf{not}\;\mathsf{false}^f \leadsto \mathsf{true}^f$ in $3$ fuel steps. Thus the reflexivity term $\langle j \rangle\,\mathsf{true}^f$ is definitionally equal at its left endpoint to the coerced transport. Certificate \texttt{certs/tcb\_r1\_univ\_bool\_ua\_not\_holonomy.2ltt.json} (21 DAG nodes, \texttt{inner\_univalence\_V = true}) checks in \texttt{KernelArena} and bridges cleanly via \texttt{rfl} in \texttt{HomotopyCRM.Vol2.CertChecks} with zero Lean axioms.
\end{proof}

guardrails.title: Ordinal-Rank Zero Base Clause
guardrails.statement: The base clause of ordinal rank completeness is rank(D) = 0 iff D is equivalent to its maximal subgroupoid D^simeq.

guardrails.title: Muchnik Meets in the Effective Topos Sublattice
guardrails.statement: In the Lawvere-Tierney topology lattice LTT(Eff), non-trivial Muchnik meets strictly dominate the identity topology: j_{O_1} /\ j_{O_2} > id_Omega.

guardrails.title: Strict Inclusion Below V_{omega+omega}
guardrails.statement: The finite-iterated powerset of N is strictly contained in V_{omega+omega} = union_n P^n(V_omega), separating Zermelo boundedness from full replacement.
